episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: An unattended call made by Ayaan to Asad is received by Rashid, and he finds Dilshad on the line. Zoya chases Ayaan on a bike to teach him a lesson after he litters in the market.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Asad is concerned that Zoya's disrespectful conduct will influence Najma. But Dilshad asks Asad to be more tolerant. Zoya asks Najma to identify a building from a half-burnt photo.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Imraan's mother gets upset to see the price tag still intact on their return gifts. Gaffur lectures Rashid to set right his son Ayaan's conduct.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Asad, Zoya and Ayaan discuss their preferences for their potential partner. Dilshad runs into Rashid at the shrine, to which she has come to pray on their 31st wedding anniversary.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Zoya's effort to make her happy delights Dilshad. Rashid lies to Shireen about being at the office. Just then, Imraan's mom comes to exchange the tux offered by Rashid's kin.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: A bubbly Zoya confronts Asad on his many objections regarding her and her stay. Haseena reads the name of Asad Ahmed Khan on the bill while trying to get the tux exchanged.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Shireen confronts Rashid about his whereabouts as he was lying. But Badi Bi covers up for Rashid. Haseena indirectly asks who is Asad Khan. Dilshad receives a gift from Rashid.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Shireen confronts Rashid about his whereabouts as he was lying. But Badi Bi covers up for Rashid. Haseena indirectly asks who is Asad Khan. Dilshad receives a gift from Rashid.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: Zoya goes to a shrine and cries over Asad's harsh comments after he bails her out of jail. Zoya meets Rashid at a shrine and offers to help him get back with his departed love.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Zoya hides Najma's short hair by placing a wig on it and stamps Asad's feet when he tries to check it. Everyone in college waits excitedly to see Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Zoya enters Najma's college in a burka and encourages a diffident Humeira to go on stage. Haseena demands that Rashid gift Imraan a luxury car.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Rashid requests an old song to be played on the radio anonymously for Dilshad. Haseena rushes into Dilshad's house asking for an unknown person to see who her husband is.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: Haseena learns about Asad's identity. Asad is annoyed to say the voice password set by Zoya every time to receive a call. Razia prompts Shireen to make Ayaan wed Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: Asad approaches Zoya furiously and asks her to fix his phone. He breaks it into pieces in a fit of anger. Razia sees Rashid trying to call Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Razia grabs Rashid's phone and makes Shireen note down the last called number. Zoya falls in Asad's arms after they both wish the worst for each other under the shooting stars.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: Ayaan finally confesses taking monetary help from Asad to buy gifts. Zoya calls Rashid and asks him to come to the same market that she is visiting with Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Haseena asks her brother Feroze to secretly find out what's the relationship between Asad and Ayaan. Zoya shares with Dilshad that she remembers her long-lost mother on seeing her.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Senior cop Feroze stops Ayaan and learns that his new bike is registered in Asad's name. Asad sees Najma and Zoya on TV in the evening at a cricket podium. He gets angry.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: Razia proposes to Rashid and Shireen that Ayaan and Humeira get married. Asad scolds Najma after she lies about going to the cricket match, and suggests that Zoya leave the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: Asad fights against goons to bring Zoya back home. When Ayaan goes to buy the items for Nikhat's engagement ritual, the cops stop him for illegal driving.

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Asad warns Feroze against holding Ayaan unlawfully without a warrant. Just as Haseena claims that she wants to break off the engagement, Ayaan reaches home.

episodesList.title: Episode 32
episodesList.summary: Razia decides to use Asad to stop Rashid and Dilshad from meeting each other. Zoya unintentionally puts Asad's important CD and the cake mixture in it into the microwave.

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: Shireen is shocked and hurt to see Rashid holding Dilshad's hand. Razia passes very unpleasant comments to Dilshad which Asad counter attacks and takes Dilshad back home.

episodesList.title: Episode 34
episodesList.summary: Zoya realises her blunder when she cuts the cake and finds a CD. Rashid gets furious at Razia for publicising his personal affairs. Razia responds suitably.

episodesList.title: Episode 35
episodesList.summary: Shireen vainly tries to sway Rashid towards her and distract him from Dilshad. Humeira has a romantic online chat with a college mate, assuming it is Ayaan on the other side.

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Shireen vainly tries to sway Rashid towards her and distract him from Dilshad. Humeira has a romantic online chat with a college mate, assuming it is Ayaan on the other side.

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: Dilshad and Najma stop Akram and Zoya from seeing each other in front of Asad. Haseena avoids talking about what was bugging her when she gets the keys to a luxury car from Razia.

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: Asad clarifies that he is not breaking Elena's heart, but only a deal. Humeira realises that her date is with a college friend and not Ayaan. She tries to run away from him.

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: Asad confronts Zoya when he learns that she had walked out of her wedding with Akram. Razia insists on getting Nikhat married to Imraan despite Haseena's unending greediness.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: Akram comes with his goons to meet Zoya and declares that he will complete their wedding forcibly. Humeira is saved by Ayaan from her harasser, who forces himself upon Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: Zoya is drugged and trapped by Akram's family so that she can be forcibly married to him. Razia tries to convince Rashid that Ayaan and Humeira are a perfect couple.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Asad prevents Zoya from being forcibly married to Akram. He fights all the goons and takes Zoya back home. Everyone surprises Shireen with a birthday party.

episodesList.title: Episode 43
episodesList.summary: Rashid falls unconscious. Later, Dilshad tells him that she has forgiven him for everything. Asad tries his best to help Zoya even after she lectures him.

episodesList.title: Episode 44
episodesList.summary: Rashid continues to play along and celebrates Shireen's birthday when he sees a present in his pocket placed by Ayaan for Shireen. Zoya misses listening to Asad's apology.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: Zoya tries to sneak into Asad's room at night in the dark to find her earrings. Asad assumes that the silhouette is that of Ayaan's and hence talks to it and hugs it. He then realises that it is Zoya. Zoya declares that she will tell everyone about Asad's secret. Asad does not want his mom to know that he meets his step-brothers and step-sisters despite his mother telling him not to meet with members of Rashid's family. Haseena tips off Feroze after Ayaan leaves the engagement ring at her house.

episodesList.title: Episode 46
episodesList.summary: Zoya blackmails Asad and makes him fulfil her demands. Ayaan is abducted by Feroze and rescued by Asad at the cost of Haseena knowing about their relationship.

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: Zoya increasingly suspects that Asad is a secret agent. Humeira is made to promise by a bruised Ayaan that she would not tell anyone that he is hurt.

episodesList.title: Episode 48
episodesList.summary: Ayaan comes to Asad secretly at night to show him Feroz's gun. Zoya sees the silhouette of Ayaan in Asad's bedroom and decides to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 49
episodesList.summary: Badi decides to prevent Gaffur from making the declaration of Ayaan's engagement. Asad confirms that Feroze and Haseena are related, and that's why Feroze was tailing them.

episodesList.title: Episode 50
episodesList.summary: Haseena calls off Imraan's engagement with Nikhat deeming it unsuitable because of Rashid's association with Asad. Later, Gaffur warns Dilshad to keep Asad away from Ayaan.

episodesList.title: Episode 51
episodesList.summary: Ayaan defends his relationship with Asad and tells his family how Asad had saved him. Further, Dilshad and Shireen want Asad and Ayaan to sever ties with each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 52
episodesList.summary: Asad and Ayaan vow to their mothers to sever all ties with each other. Further, Asad believes that Zoya told Dilshad about him meeting Ayaan, and he orders Zoya to leave his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 53
episodesList.summary: Asad learns that Gaffur told Dilshad about his meetings with Ayaan. He rushes home and asks Zoya to not leave. Further, Asad offers Haseena a house to ensure Nikhat's engagement.

episodesList.title: Episode 54
episodesList.summary: Asad is determined to protect his siblings and ensure their happiness, even if it were from a distance. Further, Nikhat and Imraan exchange engagement rings.

episodesList.title: Episode 55
episodesList.summary: Asad rushes to see Ayaan, who has been hospitalised. However, Asad is reminded of his promise and turns away from Ayaan. Later, Zoya learns about Rashid and his families.

episodesList.title: Episode 56
episodesList.summary: Zoya kidnaps Ayaan from the hospital so that Ayaan and Asad can meet. Rashid takes Ayaan away from Asad by force. Later, a furious Asad warns Zoya against interfering in his life.

episodesList.title: Episode 57
episodesList.summary: Dilshad wants Asad and Zoya to attend a wedding, but they refuse to do so. Due to a series of unfortunate events, Zoya and Asad end up on the same tractor en route to Mangalpur.

episodesList.title: Episode 58
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya arrive at Mangalpur, but Asad wants Zoya to return to Bhopal. Elsewhere, Razia intoxicates Humeira and Ayaan and locks them in a room together.

episodesList.title: Episode 59
episodesList.summary: Razia ensures that Ayaan and Humeira are found in bed together. Elsewhere, Zoya learns that Mariam is being forced to marry a rapist. Zoya further helps Mariam escape.

episodesList.title: Episode 60
episodesList.summary: Zoya escapes with Asad's help. When they seek help from the police, the police arrest them and lock them up together. Asad and Zoya escape, however, some goons follow them.

episodesList.title: Episode 61
episodesList.summary: When Zoya falls unconscious, some goons surround Asad. Further, Dilavar and his goons bury an unconscious Zoya alive. Asad is desperate to save Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 62
episodesList.summary: Asad saves Zoya, who comes back to life in his arms. Elsewhere, Ayaan and Humeira’s indiscretion makes their family members angry.

episodesList.title: Episode 63
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya return to Bhopal. Asad is tormented by his feelings for Zoya. Elsewhere, Humeira and Ayaan are tricked into attending their engagement ceremony.

episodesList.title: Episode 64
episodesList.summary: Ayaan and Humeira realise that they have been tricked into attending their engagement ceremony. Further, Ayaan and Humeira, though unwilling, are about to exchange rings.

episodesList.title: Episode 65
episodesList.summary: Nikhat stops Ayaan and Humeira's engagement and provides evidence that they did not sleep with each other. Further, Badi Bi asserts that Ayaan and Humeira do not want to marry.

episodesList.title: Episode 66
episodesList.summary: Humeira declares that she does not want to marry Ayaan. Elsewhere, Asad warns Zoya against contacting Mariam. Later, Zoya catches Mariam sneaking into Asad's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 67
episodesList.summary: Razia reminds Rashid that she knows about the crime that he had committed 17 years ago. Meanwhile, Nikhat comforts a heartbroken Humeira. Later, Zoya hides Mariam in the storeroom.

episodesList.title: Episode 68
episodesList.summary: Ayaan is livid about Rashid's decision to not leave Razia's house. Zoya tries to ensure that Mariam's presence in Asad's house is not noticed. Razia sneaks into Rashid's room.

episodesList.title: Episode 69
episodesList.summary: Asad, who realises that Zoya has been hiding Mariam, decides that Mariam needs to be sent away. Later, Dilshad brings Mariam into the house, much to Zoya's surprise.

episodesList.title: Episode 70
episodesList.summary: Dilshad learns that Rashid has been burdened by a secret for years. Further, a man enters Asad's house with a gun and in her attempt to save Mariam, Dilshad gets shot.

episodesList.title: Episode 71
episodesList.summary: Asad rushes Dilshad to the hospital. Further, Dilshad's doctor advises Asad that their relatives should be informed. Asad informs Rashid that Dilshad is fighting for her life.

episodesList.title: Episode 72
episodesList.summary: Rashid arrives at the hospital to meet Dilshad, whose heartbeats soon strengthen. Dilshad survives and is out of danger. Further, Asad initiates police action against Dilavar.

episodesList.title: Episode 73
episodesList.summary: Shireen comforts a sobbing Rashid who is relieved that Dilshad has survived. Elsewhere, Asad blames Zoya for Dilshad's shooting and forbids her from meeting Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 74
episodesList.summary: Dilshad tells Asad that she was the one who bought Mariam into the house. Further, Asad apologises to Zoya for his behaviour. However, when Zoya tries to comfort him, he walks off.

episodesList.title: Episode 75
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya realise that the gunman was aiming to kill Dilshad. Elsewhere, Razia and Gaffur discuss their failure at having Dilshad killed. Badi Bi questions Razia about Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi's suspicions about Razia being responsible for the attack on Dilshad deepen. Elsewhere, Zoya and Asad trace the security firm that employed Dilshad's assailant.

episodesList.title: Episode 77
episodesList.summary: Razia admits to Badi Bi about wanting Dilshad dead. Elsewhere, Rashid meets Dilshad but refuses to answer her questions in order to protect her from harm.

episodesList.title: Episode 78
episodesList.summary: Razia frames Badi Bi as a liar and evades her own confession of attacking Dilshad. Elsewhere, Asad and Zoya try to find Dilshad's attacker through the gun he used.

episodesList.title: Episode 79
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya question the suspects of the attack on Dilshad. They meet the final suspect, Raghu Singh, who recognises Zoya and flees before Asad can catch him.

episodesList.title: Episode 80
episodesList.summary: Zoya and Asad are told that Raghu Singh, Dilshad's attacker has committed suicide. However, Zoya recognises Raghu at a shop and follows him as he walks towards a mansion.

episodesList.title: Episode 81
episodesList.summary: Dilshad tells Asad that Rashid is trapped in a lie, but Asad refuses to believe her. Elsewhere, Badi Bi finds photographs of Rashid setting fire to the factory.

episodesList.title: Episode 82
episodesList.summary: Razia recalls how she committed a murder and led Rashid into believing that he killed someone as a result of setting a factory on fire. Asad and Zoya continue their investigation.

episodesList.title: Episode 83
episodesList.summary: Asad finds Rashid in the doll factory and thinks that Rashid shot Dilshad to hide the crimes he committed seventeen years ago. Asad is determined to make Rashid pay for his crimes.

episodesList.title: Episode 84
episodesList.summary: Rashid realises that Razia tried to kill Dilshad and in his fury, gets close to killing Razia. The police officers arrive to arrest Rashid for murder and arson on Asad's orders.

episodesList.title: Episode 85
episodesList.summary: Asad and Dilshad remain firm in their differing beliefs about Rashid's innocence. Further, Dilshad promises Rashid that she will find evidence to prove his innocence.

episodesList.title: Episode 86
episodesList.summary: Dilshad and Shireen are desperate to help Rashid and set him free. Further, Asad remains firm though Zoya, Dilshad and Ayaan try to convince him not to testify against Rashid.

episodesList.title: Episode 87
episodesList.summary: Asad learns about Zoya's fear of fire and her nightmares of being trapped in a burning building. Further, Asad learns that Zoya is in Bhopal to find the father she has never known.

episodesList.title: Episode 88
episodesList.summary: Razia sneaks inside Asad's house and learns of the recorded confession in the doll. Further, Zoya receives a letter, summoning him to testify against Rashid in court.

episodesList.title: Episode 89
episodesList.summary: Razia suspends Badi Bi by her feet as a warning against her quest to expose Razia. Further, Asad confronts Zoya about hiding the court letter, asking him to testify against Rashid.

episodesList.title: Episode 90
episodesList.summary: Zoya and Ayaan make a plan to stop Asad from testifying against Rashid. Further, Asad and Zoya find a framed photograph in an abandoned house that matches the one Zoya has.

episodesList.title: Episode 91
episodesList.summary: Razia gets threatening messages to confess her crimes before it is too late. Elsewhere, Ayaan and Zoya put their plan into action to stop Asad from testifying against Rashid.

episodesList.title: Episode 92
episodesList.summary: Zoya and Ayaan work together to ensure that Asad's car breaks down. Asad and Zoya find shelter in an abandoned house and later eat the weed laced fritters that Zoya bought.

episodesList.title: Episode 93
episodesList.summary: Zoya and Asad are intoxicated and confess their feelings for each other. Elsewhere, Badi Bi tricks Razia into confessing to her and Gaffur's framing Rashid for their crime.

episodesList.title: Episode 94
episodesList.summary: Razia injures Badi Bi by throwing her down a flight of stairs. Elsewhere, Rashid doesn't get bail. Zoya meets with an accident, and Asad rushes to the site but embraces a girl.

episodesList.title: Episode 95
episodesList.summary: Asad's old friend, Tanveer, is invited to stay with the family, making Zoya uncomfortable. Further, Ayaan learns about Rashid being tortured and seeks Asad help for their father.

episodesList.title: Episode 96
episodesList.summary: Razia is desperate to get and destroy the doll with the evidence that will exonerate Rashid. Elsewhere, Zoya is irritated and jealous of Tanveer's close bond with Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 97
episodesList.summary: Shireen, desperate to find a large amount of money to bail Rashid out of jail, instructs Ayaan to sell off her properties. Zoya is held responsible for a gas leak in Asad's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 98
episodesList.summary: Humeira tricks Gaffur into signing the property papers for Ayaan. However, the papers are intercepted by Razia who offers them to Ayaan in exchange for his marriage to Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 99
episodesList.summary: Zoya's special dish for Asad induces a severe allergic reaction to the peanuts in it, but Zoya saves him. Further, Shireen seeks help from Dilshad for Rashid's safety.

episodesList.title: Episode 100
episodesList.summary: Tanveer, Najma and Zoya bring the doll to Asad to dissuade him from testifying against Rashid. However, when he plays the audio recording, it asserts Rashid's guilt.

episodesList.title: Episode 101
episodesList.summary: Rashid is set free as a result of Ayaan's deal with Razia to marry Humeira. Further, Razia destroys the original audio recording, brought to her by Tanveer, the real Billo Rani.

episodesList.title: Episode 102
episodesList.summary: Rashid is determined to leave Razia and Gaffur's house. Further, Rashid learns about Ayaan taking money from Razia. Badi Bi shocks everyone by supporting Razia.

episodesList.title: Episode 103
episodesList.summary: Zoya is revealed to be the illegitimate daughter of Gaffur and Zainab Farooqui. It is further disclosed that Razia killed Zainab and put Zoya in an orphanage seventeen years ago.

episodesList.title: Episode 104
episodesList.summary: Feroz's statement about Asad sending Rashid to jail for revenge surfaces. Elsewhere, Tanveer slips away from Zoya. However, a worried Zoya returns to find Tanveer home already.

episodesList.title: Episode 105
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi gets her revenge for the physical harm that Razia caused her. Elsewhere, Tanveer realises that she is pregnant. Later, Tanveer calls Razia for help, but she declines.

episodesList.title: Episode 106
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells Imraan that she is pregnant, but he refuses to take responsibility. Further, Razia's insinuations about her lineage stoke Tanveer's aim to marry Asad for his wealth.

episodesList.title: Episode 107
episodesList.summary: Nikhat and Imraan's wedding date gets officially fixed, and Razia hopes to get Ayaan married to Humeira soon. Elsewhere, Tanveer's closeness to Asad irks a jealous Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 108
episodesList.summary: Zoya's search for her father leads her to a phone number. When she calls the number, Razia answers and realises that Gaffur's illegitimate daughter is indeed looking for him.

episodesList.title: Episode 109
episodesList.summary: Razia terminates Gaffur's conversation with Zoya. Razia is determined to find Zoya and keep her away from Gaffur. Asad and Ayaan resolve their differences and embrace each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 110
episodesList.summary: Razia uses Zoya's number to call and identify her among the guests at the 'Holi' party. Further, Razia offers Tanveer money in exchange for Zoya's permanent departure from India.

episodesList.title: Episode 111
episodesList.summary: Tanveer learns that Zoya is Gaffur's illegitimate daughter. She misdirects Zoya and uses the information to threaten Razia. Meanwhile, Nikhat tells Ayaan that Humeira loves him.

episodesList.title: Episode 112
episodesList.summary: Asad is misled into believing that Zoya's father has passed away. He takes Zoya to visit her father's grave. However, a distraught Zoya is unwilling to believe Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 113
episodesList.summary: Zoya grieves the loss of the father she had never known and decides to leave the country. Despite wanting to, Asad doesn't dissuade her. He learns that Zoya has bought the tickets.

episodesList.title: Episode 114
episodesList.summary: Razia wants Ayaan to mention the topic of his wedding to Humeira in front of the family. Elsewhere, Asad indirectly tells Zoya that he doesn't want her to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 115
episodesList.summary: Razia adds to Shireen's fear of black magic and warns Ayaan that unless he marries Humeira soon, Shireen would get hurt. Tanveer makes Asad think that Zoya wants to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 116
episodesList.summary: Razia's threats force Ayaan into declaring that he wants to marry Humeira, which makes Rashid and Badi Bi suspicious. Elsewhere, Tanveer's lies result in Zoya's decision to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 117
episodesList.summary: Asad records an impersonal message for Zoya, unaware that he continues to be recorded when he expresses his vulnerability. Later, Tanveer hears Asad's message and destroys the CD.

episodesList.title: Episode 118
episodesList.summary: Asad lies to make sure that Zoya stays back which infuriates Tanveer. Further, Zoya is summoned to the Immigration office and asked to leave in a day or be deported.

episodesList.title: Episode 119
episodesList.summary: Razia makes Shireen think that Dilshad is practising black magic on Ayaan because she is jealous of Shireen. Further, Zoya's immigration officer arrives at Asad's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 120
episodesList.summary: Mr. Bhatawdekar is firm on deporting Zoya, but Asad stops it by lying about him and Zoya getting engaged. Elsewhere, Razia manipulates Shireen into rushing Ayaan's engagement.

episodesList.title: Episode 121
episodesList.summary: Ayaan agrees to get engaged the next day on the condition that Asad attends the function. Ayaan informs Asad about the engagement and invites him, but Asad refuses to attend it.

episodesList.title: Episode 122
episodesList.summary: Tanveer is intent on sabotaging Humeira's engagement. Mr. Bhatawdekar drops by for an inspection at Asad's house. Elsewhere, a veiled Zoya arrives at Ayaan's engagement.

episodesList.title: Episode 123
episodesList.summary: Zoya ensures that Asad can witness Ayaan's engagement. Elsewhere, Tanveer awaits the results of her poisoned sweets. Zoya hears the tune of the orb that her father had given her.

episodesList.title: Episode 124
episodesList.summary: Zoya feeds Humeira the sweets that Tanveer had poisoned earlier. When Humeira collapses, Razia accuses Zoya of acting on Dilshad's orders to hurt Rashid's family.

episodesList.title: Episode 125
episodesList.summary: Razia refuses to listen to Zoya assert her and Dilshad's innocence. A furious Asad tells Mr. Bhatawdekar that he lied about his engagement with Zoya and allows her to be taken.

episodesList.title: Episode 126
episodesList.summary: A heartbroken Asad allows Zoya to be taken away for deportation. Dilshad informs him that everything Zoya did was for his happiness. Asad frantically looks for Zoya at the airport.

episodesList.title: Episode 127
episodesList.summary: Asad places an engagement ring on Zoya's finger and stops her from getting deported. Elsewhere, Humeira's condition worsens. Asad tells Dilshad that his engagement is fake.

episodesList.title: Episode 128
episodesList.summary: Humeira regains consciousness. Elsewhere, Tanveer intends to electrocute Zoya. However, Asad realises that something is amiss and rushes to save Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 129
episodesList.summary: Asad refuses to admit his feelings for Zoya. Further, at a relative's wedding banquet, Zoya teases Asad by talking about their engagement. Rashid and his family arrive as guests.

episodesList.title: Episode 130
episodesList.summary: Shireen accuses Dilshad of jealousy and malice. Further, Dilshad loses her temper when Shireen wishes ill for Asad. Dilshad declares that Asad shall marry within ten days.

episodesList.title: Episode 131
episodesList.summary: Dilshad wants Asad to marry Zoya within ten days. She asks Asad if he loves Zoya, to which he remains resolutely silent. Further, Tanveer declares that Asad's silence is a refusal.

episodesList.title: Episode 132
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi warns Razia that her daughter Humeira will throw her out within ten days. Elsewhere, Dilshad commands Asad to marry Zoya in ten days.

episodesList.title: Episode 133
episodesList.summary: Dilshad feigns being ill to emotionally blackmail Asad into getting married. Elsewhere, Badi Bi mocks Razia by ensuring that her hair gets cut. Later, Asad and Zoya get engaged.

episodesList.title: Episode 134
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya decide to stay engaged until Dilshad is well. Tanveer's pregnancy makes her nauseous, and she collapses. Tanveer feigns an anxiety attack in order to not be examined.

episodesList.title: Episode 135
episodesList.summary: Asad stops Dilshad from informing Zoya's sister about the engagement. Asad instructs Zoya to lie to Dilshad about her sister being ill. Tanveer needs to undertake a blood test.

episodesList.title: Episode 136
episodesList.summary: Zoya gets a sample of Tanveer's blood for the prescribed test. Later, Asad and Zoya's pre-wedding ritual commences. Elsewhere, Badi Bi's threats begin to make Razia nervous.

episodesList.title: Episode 137
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi ensures that Humeira slaps Razia to keep her conscious during convulsions. Elsewhere, Asad blames Zoya for switching Tanveer's blood sample with that of a chicken's.

episodesList.title: Episode 138
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi's jewellery goes missing from Razia's cupboard. Tanveer advises Dilshad against Asad and Zoya's wedding. A few beggars thank Razia for distributing gold coins amidst them.

episodesList.title: Episode 139
episodesList.summary: Zoya gives Asad photographic evidence of a stone-eyed person switching Tanveer's blood sample. Later, Humeira refuses to believe that Razia didn't give away Badi Bi's jewellery.

episodesList.title: Episode 140
episodesList.summary: Tanveer ruins Zoya's saree by dropping acid on it. Elsewhere, Humeira remains angry with Razia. Meanwhile, Dilshad feigns illness to ensure Asad and Zoya's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 141
episodesList.summary: Ayaan returns home from his trips. Zoya attends a pre-wedding ritual in a pair of jeans and a tunic that is made out of a saree. Dilshad tries to diffuse Asad's anger at Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 142
episodesList.summary: Asad ties a band on Zoya's arm as a symbol of their love and trust. Further, Tanveer tampers with the electric fuse and stands armed with a knife, ready to hurt Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 143
episodesList.summary: Tanveer fails at harming Zoya but wounds herself instead. Ayaan and Humeira unwittingly sign their marriage certificate. Zoya's foster sister learns of her engagement.

episodesList.title: Episode 144
episodesList.summary: Asad finds Zoya's jealousy and possessiveness amusing. Further, Asad and Ayaan meet for the first time after Ayaan's return. The brothers embrace and tease each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 145
episodesList.summary: Zoya's foster sister, Zeenat, arrives and demands to learn the truth. Asad asserts that his relationship with Zoya is real. Further, Dilshad wants Asad to confess his love to Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 146
episodesList.summary: Asad makes awkward attempts at confessing his love to Zoya. Further, Tanveer tries to kill Zoya by dropping a chandelier on her, but Zoya is shoved aside and saved.

episodesList.title: Episode 147
episodesList.summary: Razia is unable to provide Humeira and Ayaan's marriage certificate. Razia feigns illness to evade questions. Elsewhere, Asad saves Tanveer from the flames enveloping her.

episodesList.title: Episode 148
episodesList.summary: Tanveer bribes her doctor to lie about her health to Asad and his family. Elsewhere, Razia wants Haseena Bi to behave rudely with Nikhat. Asad questions Tanveer about her attacker.

episodesList.title: Episode 149
episodesList.summary: Zeenat tells Asad about Zoya witnessing her mother's death by fire and explains Zoya's fear of fire. Further, a video of Nikhat dancing becomes popular on social media.

episodesList.title: Episode 150
episodesList.summary: Ayaan defends Nikhat against Haseena Bi's accusations of indecency. Elsewhere, Asad tries to confess his love to Zoya. However, Zoya thinks that he is breaking up with her.

episodesList.title: Episode 151
episodesList.summary: Tanveer sabotages Asad's attempt to confess his love to Zoya. Further, Tanveer lies about her abusive and alcoholic husband trying to kidnap her. Zoya begins to suspect Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 152
episodesList.summary: Zoya learns that Tanveer had lied about her factory, which is still functional, burning down. Zoya orders a piece of garment from Tanveer's website to prove her lies.

episodesList.title: Episode 153
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi, under Razia's instructions, continues to treat Nikhat rudely. Elsewhere, Zoya questions Tanveer about her burnt down the factory. Asad is furious at Zoya's accusations.

episodesList.title: Episode 154
episodesList.summary: Asad makes Zoya apologise to Tanveer for accusing her of dishonesty. Elsewhere, Nikhat and Imraan get stranded when their car breaks down on their way to a Muslim saint's tomb.

episodesList.title: Episode 155
episodesList.summary: Zoya sneaks into Tanveer's room and finds the fake skin she has been using as her bruises. Elsewhere, Nikhat and Imraan are forced to spend a night at a disreputable hotel.

episodesList.title: Episode 156
episodesList.summary: Zoya realises that Tanveer faked the attacks on herself and believes that the stone-eyed person is her accomplice. Zoya realises that Tanveer doesn't want Zoya and Asad together.

episodesList.title: Episode 157
episodesList.summary: Ayaan loses his temper with Imraan when he questions Rashid's integrity. Zoya finds the knife that was used to attack Tanveer. Further, Haseena calls off Nikhat's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 158
episodesList.summary: A furious Shireen throws Ayaan out for ruining Nikhat's wedding. Elsewhere, Zoya rebukes Asad for judging her. Further, Zoya gives Rashid the knife to test it for fingerprints.

episodesList.title: Episode 159
episodesList.summary: Razia wants Ayaan to get engaged to Humeira in exchange for the resolution of Nikhat's problems. Elsewhere, Zoya learns that Tanveer is blind in her left eye.

episodesList.title: Episode 160
episodesList.summary: A livid Ayaan sets the car Imraan received as Nikhat's dowry on fire, unaware that Imraan is inside it. Elsewhere, Zoya reveals to Asad the scars from the fire her mother died in.

episodesList.title: Episode 161
episodesList.summary: Ayaan learns that the car he set on fire had Imraan stuck inside it. Elsewhere, Zoya realises that Tanveer is the stone-eyed assailant. Further, Zoya confronts Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 162
episodesList.summary: Tanveer reveals her true nature to Zoya. Tanveer warns Zoya that Asad shall make love to Tanveer. Elsewhere, Razia shows Ayaan a video of him setting Imraan's car on fire.

episodesList.title: Episode 163
episodesList.summary: Tanveer intoxicates Zoya, but she manages to conduct herself with propriety despite the drug's effect on her. Ayaan agrees to get engaged to Humeira to ensure Nikhat's happiness.

episodesList.title: Episode 164
episodesList.summary: Razia prepares for Ayaan and Humeira's engagement. Further, Haseena Bi apologises for her behaviour. Elsewhere, Tanveer warns Zoya about the 'mehndi' laced with acid.

episodesList.title: Episode 165
episodesList.summary: Zoya doesn't give Tanveer the satisfaction of watching Zoya flinch as the 'mehndi', laced with acid, burns her skin. In spite of Badi Bi's plans, Ayaan and Humeira get engaged.

episodesList.title: Episode 166
episodesList.summary: Dilshad and Asad are disturbed by the burns on Zoya's hands, but she attributes them to an allergy. Razia is deemed mentally unstable and is dragged out with Humeira's help.

episodesList.title: Episode 167
episodesList.summary: Razia gets transported to a mental asylum. Elsewhere, Asad and Zoya recall their journey from hatred to love for each other, and they realise that they are in love with each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 168
episodesList.summary: Tanveer intends to have a physical relationship with Asad. Ayaan, Nikhat, Nuzzhat and Humeira congratulate Asad on his wedding. Tanveer offers to help Razia flee from the asylum.

episodesList.title: Episode 169
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tricks Asad into following her to an abandoned warehouse as celebrations at his and Zoya's wedding commence elsewhere. Further, Tanveer strips naked an inebriated Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 170
episodesList.summary: Zoya finds a shirtless Asad in Tanveer's arms and believes him to have cheated on her. Zoya refuses to believe Asad's explanation and accuses him of cheating on her.

episodesList.title: Episode 171
episodesList.summary: Rashid loses his temper when Shireen unwittingly mocks Asad's wedding. Razia returns home to find Humeira extremely upset. Humeira insists on knowing if Ayaan loves her.

episodesList.title: Episode 172
episodesList.summary: Ayaan acknowledges that he cares for Humeira as a friend but has never loved her. Elsewhere, Asad realises that Zoya has left without her things for which Zeenat blames Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 173
episodesList.summary: Razia conspires with Tanveer to abduct Humeira and blames Ayaan's rude behaviour for Humeira's disappearance. Elsewhere, Asad is tormented by his memories of Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 174
episodesList.summary: Asad is anxious about Zoya's whereabouts while Zoya volunteers at an orphanage. Tanveer finds it difficult to buy medicines during her pregnancy. Further, Humeira remains missing for a month.

episodesList.title: Episode 175
episodesList.summary: Tanveer extorts money from Imraan. Further, Razia and Tanveer are unaware of Humeira's whereabouts. Later, Razia knocks Badi Bi out when she threatens to expose Razia.

episodesList.title: Episode 176
episodesList.summary: Razia locks a weakened Badi Bi up in the storeroom. Elsewhere, Asad finds Zoya at the orphanage and learns about how she has been punishing herself for his betrayal.

episodesList.title: Episode 177
episodesList.summary: Tanveer hides Zoya's unconscious body behind a wall. However, Asad manages to save Zoya by breaking the wall down. Elsewhere, Humeira returns home but has no memory of herself.

episodesList.title: Episode 178
episodesList.summary: Asad, having lost Zoya, breaks down in Dilshad's arms. Later, Asad visits the shrine at Ajmer to seek solace and pray for Zoya's return, unaware that Zoya is only a few feet apart.

episodesList.title: Episode 179
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya meet in Ajmer. Further, Asad confesses his deep and abiding love for Zoya. However, Zoya deems Asad's confession too late and his betrayal unforgivable.

episodesList.title: Episode 180
episodesList.summary: Humeira's behaviour deepens the mystery of her mistaken identity. Elsewhere, Zoya realises that Asad is innocent and had been drugged by Tanveer. Tanveer learns that Zoya is alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 181
episodesList.summary: Ayaan begins to develop feelings for Humeira who is operating under a delusion to escape the trauma of her accident. Elsewhere, Tanveer attacks Zoya and keeps her from seeing Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 182
episodesList.summary: Zoya confronts Tanveer about drugging Asad. Elsewhere, Humeira gets upset by Shireen's persistence in not calling her Rajni. Further, Tanveer pushes Zoya off a cliff to kill her.

episodesList.title: Episode 183
episodesList.summary: Tanveer pushes Zoya off a cliff, confident about Zoya's death. However, Zoya grapples and climbs her way to safety. Zoya is determined to return to Asad and defeat Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 184
episodesList.summary: Imraan wears a letter 'N' on a chain around his neck. Elsewhere, an unconscious Zoya imagines herself dancing with Asad. Later, Razia hides an inert Badi Bi in an unused wardrobe.

episodesList.title: Episode 185
episodesList.summary: Zoya wants a fresh start for her and Asad's relationship. Elsewhere, Humeira comes remarkably close to finding Badi Bi in Razia's cupboard. Meanwhile, Zoya wants Tanveer to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 186
episodesList.summary: Asad in order to fulfil his duty to his unborn child with Tanveer, refuses to marry Zoya and declares his decision to marry Tanveer. Zoya slaps Tanveer for her filthy malice.

episodesList.title: Episode 187
episodesList.summary: Ayaan and Humeira come remarkably close to finding Badi Bi in Razia's cupboard. Elsewhere, Tanveer tells Zoya that her father is alive and offers to reveal his identity.

episodesList.title: Episode 188
episodesList.summary: Dilshad is against Asad marrying Tanveer. Further, Rashid questions Razia regarding Badi Bi's whereabouts. Later, Tanveer tells Zoya that she knows about Zoya's father's identity.

episodesList.title: Episode 189
episodesList.summary: Humeira unlocks Razia's cupboard but doesn't find anything suspicious since Razia had already moved Badi Bi. Asad declares that he will marry Tanveer on Friday.

episodesList.title: Episode 190
episodesList.summary: Razia misleads Rashid into thinking that Badi Bi is well and volunteering at an orphanage. Elsewhere, Zoya searches Tanveer's room. Further, Zoya realises that Tanveer is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Episode 191
episodesList.summary: Nikhat and Imraan's wedding date is fixed. A malicious Haseena tries to trick Humeira into eating meat. Elsewhere, Zoya supports Asad's decision and decides to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 192
episodesList.summary: Zoya follows Tanveer's instructions and goes to the religious meeting where Razia and Gaffur are present. However, Razia ensures that Zoya doesn't learn that Gaffur is her father.

episodesList.title: Episode 193
episodesList.summary: Zoya learns that Tanveer has been pregnant for over three months and that the child isn't Asad's. Elsewhere, Humeira frantically searches for Rajni's husband, Vikram, at a temple.

episodesList.title: Episode 194
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tries to set Zoya on fire and enumerates the times she has tried to kill Zoya, and Asad overhears her. Elsewhere, Rajni's husband Vikram Shukla comes for his wife Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 195
episodesList.summary: A livid Asad commands Tanveer to leave. Elsewhere, Vikram shows an angry Ayaan a picture of himself and Humeira. Further, Asad asks Zoya to marry him, and she accepts his proposal.

episodesList.title: Episode 196
episodesList.summary: Dilshad wants Asad and Zoya to get married soon. Elsewhere, Ayaan stops Humeira from leaving with Vikram. Further, a jealous Ayaan barges into Humeira's room to ensure her safety.

episodesList.title: Episode 197
episodesList.summary: Asad finds Zoya's wish list for her husband. Razia drags Badi Bi's inert body away from her room to hide, when she stumbles upon Vikram running away with stolen jewellery.

episodesList.title: Episode 198
episodesList.summary: Razia gives the thief, pretending to be Vikram cash in exchange for his departure. Elsewhere, Asad tries to make Ayaan realise that he has fallen in love with Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 199
episodesList.summary: Razia pays Vikram to help her dispose of Badi Bi's inert body. Ayaan is upset by Vikram's presence in Humeira's life. Elsewhere, Asad performs to a Salman Khan song for Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 200
episodesList.summary: Asad fulfils one of Zoya's wishes by decorating her room with stars that glow in the dark. Elsewhere, Razia and Vikram drag Badi Bi out and stow her in a car to dispose her off.

episodesList.title: Episode 201
episodesList.summary: Asad encapsulates the Moon in Zoya's engagement ring. Elsewhere, Nikhat demands that Haseena stop making unreasonable demands from Rashid. However, Imraan shows Nikhat no support.

episodesList.title: Episode 202
episodesList.summary: Rashid cancels Nikhat and Imraan's wedding without even a mild protest from Imraan. Elsewhere, Asad learns that Zoya's father is alive and vows to find him for her.

episodesList.title: Episode 203
episodesList.summary: Imraan embraces Najma whom he has been in love with for years since they were in college together. Asad presents Zoya with the repaired musical orb.

episodesList.title: Episode 204
episodesList.summary: Vikram tries to force himself on Humeira, who slaps him. A distraught Humeira seeks comfort in Ayaan's embrace. Imraan, Najma, and Nikhat are uncertain about their future.

episodesList.title: Episode 205
episodesList.summary: Imraan refuses to succumb to Tanveer's blackmail about their illegitimate child. Elsewhere, Humeira is confused by her attraction towards Ayaan as opposed to her husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 206
episodesList.summary: Ayaan exposes Vikram's truth to Humeira and wants her to remember herself. Asad and Zoya, with Ayaan's help, rescue Badi Bi from Razia and expose her lies and vile malice.

episodesList.title: Episode 207
episodesList.summary: Zoya is assured that her father is still alive. Rashid and Badi Bi are determined to punish Razia for her crimes. Elsewhere, Zoya wants to fulfil Asad's wishes.

episodesList.title: Episode 208
episodesList.summary: Razia is made to work at a spice factory as punishment for her crimes. Ayaan brings a weak Humeira back home. Elsewhere, Zoya fulfils Asad's wish to watch her sleep.

episodesList.title: Episode 209
episodesList.summary: Tanveer extorts money from Imraan to keep his illegitimate child with her a secret from Najma. Elsewhere, Shireen is worried about Ayaan's anxiety regarding Humeira's health.

episodesList.title: Episode 210
episodesList.summary: Najma tells Asad that she is in love with someone. However, he is shocked to learn that Najma loves Imraan. Elsewhere, Ayaan reminds Nikhat that Imraan never supported her.

episodesList.title: Episode 211
episodesList.summary: Razia escapes from the factory. Imraan seeks Najma's hand in marriage, but Asad wants Nikhat's approval. Elsewhere, Humeira awakens as herself with her memories intact.

episodesList.title: Episode 212
episodesList.summary: Humeira is disturbed by her lapse in memory. For Asad's sake, Nikhat pretends to be indifferent about Imraan. Elsewhere, Imraan informs Haseena that he is in love with Najma.

episodesList.title: Episode 213
episodesList.summary: Ayaan is unable to confess his love to Humeira, who believes him to be indifferent towards her. Nikhat and Najma dress up with care, as they nurture hopes of a future with Imraan.

episodesList.title: Episode 214
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise and further escalate when the matter of Najma and Imraan's wedding is brought up in Nikhat's presence. Imraan confesses to having loved Najma for years.

episodesList.title: Episode 215
episodesList.summary: Nikhat asserts that Imraan and Najma should get married and also wishes them a happy married life. Later, Nikhat breaks down in private but is determined to move on for her family.

episodesList.title: Episode 216
episodesList.summary: Ayaan is afraid of losing Humeira and convinces Rashid to let Razia stay. Nikhat assures Asad and Ayaan that she is happy about Imraan and Najma's union.

episodesList.title: Episode 217
episodesList.summary: Humeira mourns her unrequited love for Ayaan, unaware of the fact that he loves her deeply. Zoya gets curious when she receives a call for Imraan from a maternity hospital.

episodesList.title: Episode 218
episodesList.summary: Zoya dresses up as the actress that Asad had a crush on as a child in order to surprise him. Elsewhere, Haseena Bi seeks Nikhat's hand in marriage for her elder son, Farhan.

episodesList.title: Episode 219
episodesList.summary: Nikhat comes across Imraan and Najma at a park and realises that she needs to move on. Further, Nikhat agrees to marry Farhan despite Rashid and Ayaan's reservations about it.

episodesList.title: Episode 220
episodesList.summary: Ayaan learns from Razia that Humeira has an abnormality in her cardiac muscles. Elsewhere, Asad is worried about Zoya's safe return while she hitches a ride from a stranger.

episodesList.title: Episode 221
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya have a spat about the latter's behaviour. Humeira comforts a distressed Nikhat. Further, Humeira throws away her medicines. Asad and Zoya apologise to each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 222
episodesList.summary: Asad doesn't find Rajveer trustworthy and argues with Zoya. Humeira reveals her knowledge about her cardiac abnormality. She threatens to commit suicide unless Ayaan leaves.

episodesList.title: Episode 223
episodesList.summary: Humeira learns from Nikhat how Ayaan protected her because he is in love with her. Further, Nikhat and Farhan's wedding is fixed, and Asad learns about it.

episodesList.title: Episode 224
episodesList.summary: Imraan receives a doll of a baby as a threat from Tanveer. Later, when Imraan and Najma are about to exchange engagement rings, Imraan notices a veiled Tanveer amidst the guests.

episodesList.title: Episode 225
episodesList.summary: Tanveer blackmails Imraan with the prospect of exposing their illegitimate child unless she is paid an extravagant amount of money. Zoya catches Imraan speaking with Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 226
episodesList.summary: Humeira apologises to Ayaan for not recognising his love earlier and seeks to start afresh. Elsewhere, Zoya exposes Rajveer for the misogynist that he is and slaps him in public.

episodesList.title: Episode 227
episodesList.summary: Dilshad and Asad wish for Rashid's presence in their lives. Najma arrives at Rashid's house to invite his family to her wedding the next day, and Badi Bi accepts the invitation.

episodesList.title: Episode 228
episodesList.summary: Nikhat accepts Najma's wedding invitation. Further, Nikhat is introduced to Farhan. Elsewhere, Rashid gives Zoya birthday gifts for Asad. Later, Zoya sees Imraan with Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 229
episodesList.summary: Zoya's suspicion about Imraan and Tanveer’s association deepens. Elsewhere, tensions rise when Ayaan realises that his car is being followed.

episodesList.title: Episode 230
episodesList.summary: Vikram and his goons surround Ayaan and Humeira. Elsewhere, Zoya's determination to protect Najma leads to her walking into a trap laid for her by Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 231
episodesList.summary: Tanveer, with the help of goons, binds and gags Zoya so that she might be slowly poisoned. Elsewhere, Ayaan fights Vikram and his goons to protect Humeira from being taken by them.

episodesList.title: Episode 232
episodesList.summary: Ayaan and Zoya try to evade the goons who are looking for them. They disguise as a groom and a bride in a collective wedding ceremony. Later, unbeknownst to them, they get married.

episodesList.title: Episode 233
episodesList.summary: Ayaan and Zoya are shocked when they realise their mistake but try to brush it off. Further, Zoya rushes home but is unable to stop Najma and Imraan's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 234
episodesList.summary: Ayaan's family learns of his accidental marriage to Zoya and is shocked by it. Haseena Bi maliciously terminates Farhan's marriage to Nikhat, causing her to attempt suicide.

episodesList.title: Episode 235
episodesList.summary: Asad is shattered when he learns that Ayaan and Zoya have accidentally gotten married. Further, Ayaan begs Asad to let Zoya act as his wife till Nikhat is married to Farhan.

episodesList.title: Episode 236
episodesList.summary: Asad makes a difficult decision and takes Zoya to Ayaan's house. Further, a heartbroken Asad hands Zoya over to Ayaan as his wife while an equally heartbroken Humeira looks on.

episodesList.title: Episode 237
episodesList.summary: Razia wants Ayaan to choose Humeira's love over Nikhat's life. Shireen begs Asad to convince Zoya to sign the marriage certificate to save Nikhat's life.

episodesList.title: Episode 238
episodesList.summary: Ayaan and Zoya sign their marriage certificate in order to save Nikhat. Further, Dilshad learns about Ayaan and Zoya's accidental wedding and chafes at the injustice of fate.

episodesList.title: Episode 239
episodesList.summary: Zoya refuses to stay away from Asad and loses her temper at both Asad and Ayaan for their disregard for her. Razia realises that Zoya and Ayaan must stay married for three months.

episodesList.title: Episode 240
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya are disturbed by their memories of each other. Similarly, Ayaan and Humeira mourn losing each other. Further, Razia is determined to keep Zoya's paternity a secret.

episodesList.title: Episode 241
episodesList.summary: Gaffur is convinced by Razia to leave for Indore. Rashid assures to protect Zoya from any distress. Najma learns of her engagement with Farhan. Later, Asad telephones Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 242
episodesList.summary: Najma is ill-treated by Haseena. Ayaan tells Zoya about Nikhat's marriage. Meanwhile, Asad waits outside Ayaan's house to see Zoya. Later, Farhan's family visits Nikhat's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 243
episodesList.summary: Nikhat and Farhan's engagement ceremony commences. Tanveer is dragged out of the office by Asad. Najma is forced to gift her necklace to Nikhat. Najma later asks Zoya to meet Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 244
episodesList.summary: Zoya confronts Imraan about Tanveer and asks him to disclose the matter to Najma. Dilshad encourages Asad to disclose the truth to Zoya. Later, Najma accidentally hurts Ayaan.

episodesList.title: Episode 245
episodesList.summary: Razia clicks pictures of Asad and Zoya embracing each other. Soon, Humeira and Ayaan make amends. Najma is ill-treated by Haseena. Later, Humeira notices Ayaan and Zoya together.

episodesList.title: Episode 246
episodesList.summary: Both Zoya and Ayaan claim to be Salman Khan's biggest fans. Meanwhile, Asad is blackmailed by Tanveer. Later, Zoya is asked to accept the reality of being Ayaan's wife by Badi Bi.

episodesList.title: Episode 247
episodesList.summary: During Nikhat's 'haldi' ceremony, Ayaan accidentally collides with Zoya. Further, Zoya being asked to fulfil her duties upsets Humeira. Later, Zoya visits Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 248
episodesList.summary: Zoya offers words of encouragement to Humeira. Later, Tanveer threatens to harm Zoya. Haseena is constantly provocative towards Zoya and Asad during Farhan's 'haldi' ceremony.

episodesList.title: Episode 249
episodesList.summary: Asad throws away Zoya's bag when Tanveer lies to him about placing a scorpion in it. Soon, Razia contaminates Zoya's cosmetics. Later, Zoya decides to use her cosmetics on Nikhat.

episodesList.title: Episode 250
episodesList.summary: Razia tries to frame Zoya for harming Humeira. Tanveer orchestrates Farhan's kidnapping. Haseena blames Zoya for Farhan's disappearance. Later, Asad brings Farhan to his wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 251
episodesList.summary: Ayaan remains with Humeira and informs her about the wedding proceedings. Meanwhile, Nikhat is welcomed home by her in-laws. Subsequently, Asad receives a present from Badi Bi.

episodesList.title: Episode 252
episodesList.summary: Farhan drugs Nikhat and spends his time with another woman. Najma is prevented from finding out about Farhan's secret deed. Later, Zoya's journey to Asad's house is interrupted.

episodesList.title: Episode 253
episodesList.summary: Ayaan loses consciousness on the road. Zoya manages to bring Ayaan to a hospital. Meanwhile, Najma senses that a secret is being kept from her. Later, Asad comforts Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 254
episodesList.summary: Ayaan's family visits him at the hospital. Elsewhere, Nikhat questions Farhan about his wet clothes. Ayaan later apologises to Asad over the phone, and Zoya is visited by Razia.

episodesList.title: Episode 255
episodesList.summary: Farhan lies to Nikhat about the scars on his back. Haseena ill-treats Nikhat at breakfast. Zoya performs resuscitation on Ayaan when he stops breathing. Asad waits for Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 256
episodesList.summary: Zoya escorts Asad to Ayaan's room. Razia manipulates Humeira. Later, Razia manipulates Shireen against Zoya and Asad. Razia and Shireen look on as Zoya and Asad embrace each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 257
episodesList.summary: Zoya asks Humeira to look after Ayaan. Haseena is disrespectful towards Nikhat. Later, Razia and Shireen notice Asad and Zoya together. Elsewhere, Farhan fails to drug Nikhat.

episodesList.title: Episode 258
episodesList.summary: Ayaan decides to look for Zoya despite Humeira's protests. Meanwhile, Humeira misunderstands Zoya and Ayaan's closeness. Later, Asad is forced to call the police on Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 259
episodesList.summary: Tanveer lies to the police about Asad assaulting her. Meanwhile, Zoya is furious with Asad and refuses to speak to him. Later, Nikhat spots Farhan spiking her dessert.

episodesList.title: Episode 260
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi and Shireen ask Zoya to perform a post-wedding ritual. Soon, Nikhat discloses to Farhan that she is aware of the spiked dessert. Later, Razia and Tanveer plot against Zoya

episodesList.title: Episode 261
episodesList.summary: Ayaan cooks instead of Zoya, and Humeira misunderstands their relationship. Later, two reporters, who state that Razia has called them, want to cover Ayaan and Zoya’s story.

episodesList.title: Episode 262
episodesList.summary: Zoya tells Asad that she will have to stay for two more days. Tanveer praises Razia as Razia has understood her plan. Humeira misunderstands Zoya and Ayaan’s relationship.

episodesList.title: Episode 263
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi wants to send Imraan and Najma, and Farhan and Nikhat on their honeymoon. Razia plots against Zoya and pours soap water on the stairs.

episodesList.title: Episode 264
episodesList.summary: Razia accuses Zoya of poisoning the juice, and Ayaan drinks it. Later, Ayaan falls unconscious in his room. At Asad’s office, Tanveer shows her wedding card to Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 265
episodesList.summary: Tanveer gives a choice to Asad to marry her in order to save Najma’s married life. Ayaan feels better after vomiting and tells Zoya that he was aware of Razia poisoning the juice.

episodesList.title: Episode 266
episodesList.summary: Zoya agrees to leave the house. Tanveer blackmails Asad to marry her. Najma tells Imraan that she trusts him. Later, Tanveer tells the mosque committee members that she's pregnant.

episodesList.title: Episode 267
episodesList.summary: Asad states that Imraan is the father of Tanveer's child and also reveals Tanveer's truth to the committee. The reporters arrive for Zoya and Ayaan's interview at Ayaan's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 268
episodesList.summary: Asad tells Zoya to come along with him and argues with the family members. Badi Bi states that she wants to know Zoya’s decision. Thereafter, Zoya chooses to go with Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 269
episodesList.summary: Shireen and Rashid argue with each other. Dilshad asks Najma to take care of Nikhat, and Shireen warns Nikhat to be careful of Najma. Later, Zoya kisses Asad, and they dance.

episodesList.title: Episode 270
episodesList.summary: Rashid meets with an accident, and Dilshad happens to be present at the accident spot. Soon after, Haseena Bi tells Nikhat to ask for INR 25 lakhs from her father.

episodesList.title: Episode 271
episodesList.summary: Nikhat tells Rashid that she needs money. Thereafter, Asad informs Ayaan about Zoya’s birthday and shares his plan with him. Later, Asad pretends to have forgotten Zoya's birthday.

episodesList.title: Episode 272
episodesList.summary: Rashid wants to live with Dilshad. Further, Asad makes arrangements to surprise Zoya on her birthday. Najma, Imraan, Nikhat and Farhan arrive at a resort, but Farhan leaves soon.

episodesList.title: Episode 273
episodesList.summary: Razia wonders if someone knows about the doll factory conspiracy. Meanwhile, Haseena Bi lands up at her sons’ honeymoon. Humeira and Ayaan later enact Zoya and Asad’s love story.

episodesList.title: Episode 274
episodesList.summary: Humeira and Ayaan play Zoya's and Asad's roles respectively. Dilshad tells Rashid that she is thinking about his proposal. Najma tells Nikhat that Haseena Bi has deceived her.

episodesList.title: Episode 275
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi returns the money to Nikhat and decides to create a rift between Najma and Nikhat. Razia learns that she will receive a gift. Haseena Bi instigates Najma against Nikhat.

episodesList.title: Episode 276
episodesList.summary: Zoya challenges Asad to spend a day of his life like her. Dilshad asks Rashid to speak to Shireen, and he agrees. Razia finds a note stating that she will receive her gift soon.

episodesList.title: Episode 277
episodesList.summary: Razia is shocked to know about Tanveer’s mental condition. At the resort, Haseena Bi plots against Nikhat. A huge gift arrives for Razia, and Ayaan finds a refrigerator inside it.

episodesList.title: Episode 278
episodesList.summary: Razia reads a letter, which states that she will pay for her sins. Razia is shocked to know that the blackmailer is calling from her home number. Later, Razia embarrasses Gaffur.

episodesList.title: Episode 279
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi instigates Najma against Nikhat. Dilshad tells Rashid that she is ready to live with him. Later, Razia tells Shireen about Rashid and Dilshad meeting each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 280
episodesList.summary: Rashid tells Shireen that Dilshad will be living with them. Meanwhile, Haseena Bi conspires against Nikhat. Rashid later tells Asad that he wants Dilshad to live with him.

episodesList.title: Episode 281
episodesList.summary: Asad is shocked to learn about Dilshad's decision. Razia provokes Shireen against Dilshad and asks her to revolt against Rashid’s decision. Haseena Bi pushes Nikhat towards Imraan.

episodesList.title: Episode 282
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi insults Nikhat and tries to instigate Najma against Nikhat. Asad apologises to Dilshad but thinks that Rashid is a liar. Ayaan later proposes marriage to Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 283
episodesList.summary: Zoya tries to persuade Asad to let Dilshad go to Rashid. Farhan tells Nikhat that she is his second wife. Shireen later tells Ayaan about Rashid's decision to live with Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 284
episodesList.summary: Dilshad tells Zoya that she and Rashid are not divorced. Razia finds her picture marked as a murderer in the garden. Rashid tries to stop Shireen and Ayaan from leaving the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 285
episodesList.summary: Shireen changes her decision of leaving Rashid. Nikhat decides to stay with Farhan and help him find Sameera. When Ayaan is about to leave the house, Dilshad arrives there.

episodesList.title: Episode 286
episodesList.summary: Rashid feels unwell when Ayaan leaves the house. A heartbroken Humeira tells Razia that she does not care about Ayaan anymore. Razia later finds a blood-smeared doll in her room.

episodesList.title: Episode 287
episodesList.summary: When Asad learns from Zoya that Dilshad has chosen Rashid over him, he decides to relocate to New York along with Zoya. Meanwhile, Haider arrives at the Siddiqui Mansion.

episodesList.title: Episode 288
episodesList.summary: Asad informs Dilshad that he is moving abroad. Further, Zoya decides not to go with Asad, but later she tries to stop him. On the other hand, Razia sees a man lying on the floor.

episodesList.title: Episode 289
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya meet at the mosque. Dilshad informs Asad about Rashid's ill health. Asad changes his decision of leaving the city. Shruti decides to stay in the marriage with Sanjay.

episodesList.title: Episode 290
episodesList.summary: Razia nearly escapes a death trap. Haseena plans to create a rift between Nikhat and Najma. Shireen blames Dilshad and Asad for Rashid's condition. Asad returns home with Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 291
episodesList.summary: Dilshad takes Asad and Zoya to an unresponsive Rashid. Razia instigates Shireen against Dilshad and Asad. Shireen later tells Asad that he can’t live in Ayaan’s room.

episodesList.title: Episode 292
episodesList.summary: Haider teases Humeira. Elsewhere, Haseena Bi stops Nikhat from following the sound of the anklets. Haider asks Razia to sign some contract papers while holding a knife in his hand.

episodesList.title: Episode 293
episodesList.summary: Nikhat tells Najma about hearing the sound of anklets. When Humeira steps on broken glass, Haider tends to her wounds. Razia later tells Haseena Bi about Dilshad living with them.

episodesList.title: Episode 294
episodesList.summary: Asad rebukes Haseena Bi for insulting Dilshad. He also gets into an argument with Razia and Shireen. Dilshad tells Razia that she will not leave the house as she is Rashid's wife.

episodesList.title: Episode 295
episodesList.summary: Shireen gets Ayaan's letter. Razia plans to hurt Zoya to hurt Dilshad. Nikhat hears strange sounds from the bathroom sink. Haider pretends to have broken his bones before Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 296
episodesList.summary: Nikhat tells Najma about the strange sounds coming from the sink. Razia uses Zoya's fake pictures on some pamphlets. Gaffur then confronts Zoya about her pictures on the pamphlets.

episodesList.title: Episode 297
episodesList.summary: Gaffur asks Zoya to change her clothing. Nikhat finds bloodstains under the carpet. Haseena Bi and Razia discuss Zoya's fake pictures in front of some women of their community.

episodesList.title: Episode 298
episodesList.summary: Haider takes the disguise of a girl. Farhan gifts a ring to Nikhat. Some women from Razia's community try to throw Zoya out of the house, but Asad comes for her rescue.

episodesList.title: Episode 299
episodesList.summary: Nikhat sees the silhouette of a woman at night and gets terrified. On the other hand, Razia spikes Zoya’s water, and later she also accuses Zoya and Asad of having an affair.

episodesList.title: Episode 300
episodesList.summary: Nikhat confronts Haseena Bi about not telling her anything regarding Sameera. Farhan stops Haseena Bi from sending Nikhat away. Asad bids farewell to Rashid before leaving.

episodesList.title: Episode 301
episodesList.summary: Asad learns that Rashid has transferred all his properties and business to his name. An unknown man coerces Razia to come to a secluded location to kill her.

episodesList.title: Episode 302
episodesList.summary: Haider tries to kill Razia, but she escapes. Haseena Bi locks Sameera in a secret basement after the latter tries to approach Nikhat. Razia gets suspicious seeing Haider’s injury.

episodesList.title: Episode 303
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi manages to stop the secret basement from being exposed. Meanwhile, Zoya and Dilshad plan to prove Rashid’s innocence and also start searching for the property papers.

episodesList.title: Episode 304
episodesList.summary: Haider pledges to take revenge after recollecting the tragic incident from his childhood. Nikhat, on the other hand, is convinced that Sameera’s spirit is causing all the problems.

episodesList.title: Episode 305
episodesList.summary: Razia confronts Zoya and asks her to show the property papers. However, Zoya fools Razia and Gaffur by showing blank property papers. Razia later plans to teach Zoya a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 306
episodesList.summary: Haider saves Zoya and Dilshad as Razia tries to throw them out of the house. Meanwhile, Farhan is upset with Nikhat for hurting his sentiments regarding Sameera.

episodesList.title: Episode 307
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi helps Zoya and Dilshad to stop Razia from exposing them. Nikhat, on the other hand, gets terrified after seeing Sameera and confronts Haseena Bi about the same.

episodesList.title: Episode 308
episodesList.summary: Haseena Bi emotionally manipulates Farhan and instigates him against Nikhat. Badi Bi, on the other hand, swiftly retrieves the property papers from Razia’s room.

episodesList.title: Episode 309
episodesList.summary: Gaffur and Razia are unable to meet the lawyer. Haider ensures Gaffur and Razia are busy with the guests so that Zoya gets more time to search for the original property papers.

episodesList.title: Episode 310
episodesList.summary: Haider comes across the original property papers but does not notice them. Meanwhile, a man later informs Gaffur that a few years ago a girl was searching for him.

episodesList.title: Episode 311
episodesList.summary: Gaffur thinks about what Tanveer and the other man had told him about his lost daughter. Afterwards, the police arrest Zoya for showing fake property papers to Razia and Gaffur.

episodesList.title: Episode 312
episodesList.summary: Zoya finds the original property papers at the right time to prevent her arrest. Haseena Bi plans to torture Najma and Nikhat. Afterwards, Zoya taunts and challenges Razia.

episodesList.title: Episode 313
episodesList.summary: Gaffur tells a sketch artist to create a sketch of his lost daughter with the help of the man, who had seen her. Razia, however, worries that all her secrets will be exposed.

episodesList.title: Episode 314
episodesList.summary: Rashid regains consciousness and signals that Razia had pushed him from the staircase. Razia, on the other hand, plans to kill Zoya in order to save herself from getting exposed.

episodesList.title: Episode 315
episodesList.summary: Zoya stops Razia from trying to kill Rashid. Humeira accuses Haider of molesting her. Afterwards, Razia lures Dilshad out of Rashid’s room in order to kill him.

episodesList.title: Episode 316
episodesList.summary: Zoya fails to prove that Razia tried to get Rashid killed. Haider abducts Humeira but does not harm her. Later, Razia tries to kill Zoya by burning her, but Asad comes to her aid.

episodesList.title: Episode 317
episodesList.summary: Asad saves Zoya. Further, Haseena plans on proving that Nikhat is insane. Later, Zoya and Asad expose Razia. Meanwhile, Humeira and Haider are unable to find their way back home.

episodesList.title: Episode 318
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya fail to prove that Razia is the culprit. Haseena changes the 'lehenga saree' that Farhan brought for Nikhat with another dress. Later, Humeira and Haider eat fruits.

episodesList.title: Episode 319
episodesList.summary: Asad takes the responsibility of Rashid's business, much to Razia and Gaffur's shock. Meanwhile, Nikhat falls into Haseena's trap. Later, Zoya plans to record Razia's confession.

episodesList.title: Episode 320
episodesList.summary: Razia refuses to reveal her ploys to Zoya. Later, Asad devises a plan to disclose Razia’s deeds. When nobody believes Nikhat, she picks up a knife and accidentally injures Imran.

episodesList.title: Episode 321
episodesList.summary: Najma decides to stay away from Nikhat and rebukes her for her conduct. Razia falls for Zoya and Asad's trap. Later, Gaffur visits Tanveer and asks her about his second daughter.

episodesList.title: Episode 322
episodesList.summary: Asad devises a plan to trap Razia, and the latter initially falls for it. Najma refuses to interact with Nikhat and ignores her. Later, Gaffur apologises to Rashid for his actions.

episodesList.title: Episode 323
episodesList.summary: Rashid records Gaffur's confession on Zoya's phone. However, Zoya could not hear the recording due to her sister's phone call. Later, Haider stops himself from kissing Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 324
episodesList.summary: Nikhat fails to make Farhan understand that Haseena is plotting against her. Afterwards, Asad announces Gaffur's retirement as the CEO of the company in a press conference.

episodesList.title: Episode 325
episodesList.summary: Asad decides to make an announcement at the party. Further, Tanveer reveals to Gaffur that she is not insane. Later, Razia reads the message that Rashid wrote for Zoya to read.

episodesList.title: Episode 326
episodesList.summary: Razia learns about the recording and plans to kill Zoya, but Gaffur stops her. Later, Haider tells Gaffur that he is going to avenge his parents' death by spoiling Humeira's life.

episodesList.title: Episode 327
episodesList.summary: Gaffur agrees on getting Zoya killed. Later, at the party, Razia signals her man to kill Zoya. Further, Gaffur runs towards the sound, which comes from a music box that Zoya owns.

episodesList.title: Episode 328
episodesList.summary: The killer fails to kill Zoya, but later he abducts her. Meanwhile, Tanveer collects Gaffur's signatures on some papers and discloses to him that Zoya is his daughter.

episodesList.title: Episode 329
episodesList.summary: Gaffur asks Razia not to kill Zoya. However, Razia stays adamant. Everyone prays for Zoya. Later, Gaffur informs Asad about Zoya's location, and he along with Haider rescues Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 330
episodesList.summary: Gaffur is glad to see Zoya safe, but Razia is not. Asad blames Razia and Gaffur for trying to kill Zoya. Further, Nikhat finds a secret room and sees an ill woman inside the room.

episodesList.title: Episode 331
episodesList.summary: Razia warns Gaffur against disclosing to Zoya that he is her father. Haseena and Chaand make Nikhat drink spiked water. Further, Asad decides to call the police on Gaffur.

episodesList.title: Episode 332
episodesList.summary: Asad fails to apologise to Zoya. Nikhat learns about Haseena's plan. Gaffur asks Tanveer not to come to his house. Later, Humeira and Zoya find out about Asad's bachelor party.

episodesList.title: Episode 333
episodesList.summary: Zoya apologises to Asad for not trusting him. Nikhat is taken to a mental asylum for killing Farhan. However, Farhan arrives with Sameera and Haseena, and they smile at Nikhat.

episodesList.title: Episode 334
episodesList.summary: Tanveer arrives at Gaffur's house and discloses to be Gaffur's second wife. Humeira decries Gaffur's act. Later, Haider promises to be with Humeira while smirking at the same time.

episodesList.title: Episode 335
episodesList.summary: Zoya and Asad doubt Tanveer's intentions. Further, Haseena asks a worried Najma to spend time at her brother's house. Later, Asad refuses to take any kind of help from Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 336
episodesList.summary: Farhan, Sameera and Haseena rejoice how they had trapped Nikhat. Meanwhile, Humeira assaults Tanveer. Later, Asad tells a curious Zoya that they will be marrying at the Taj Mahal.

episodesList.title: Episode 337
episodesList.summary: Tanveer fails to find out about Zoya and Asad's wedding location. Later, she applies 'haldi' to Zoya and Asad. Later, Gaffur rebukes Haider for trying to get close to Humeira.

episodesList.title: Episode 338
episodesList.summary: When Haider tries to kiss Humeira, Gaffur slaps him. Further, Haider threatens Gaffur with ruining Humeira's life. Razia has a spat with Tanveer. Later, Asad names a star Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 339
episodesList.summary: Haider sends a letter to Humeira asking for her consent to elope. Later, Gaffur applies 'mehendi' on Zoya's hand.

episodesList.title: Episode 340
episodesList.summary: Razia warns Gaffur about his conduct, but he refuses to listen to her. Haider and Humeira elope at night. Later, Zoya wonders about Gaffur's connection behind the anonymous gifts.

episodesList.title: Episode 341
episodesList.summary: Gaffur decides to look for Humeira and goes to Agra. Gaffur is overwhelmed to see Zoya in her wedding attire. Later, Zoya and Asad are married, and they share a romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Episode 342
episodesList.summary: Zoya gets a clue about her father's identity. Gaffur reaches the hotel to save Humeira from Haider. Later, Gaffur feels helpless after learning about Humeira and Haider's actions.

episodesList.title: Episode 343
episodesList.summary: Haider comforts an upset Humeira. Farhan and Haseena choke Nikhat to death. Further, Zoya tells Asad about the anonymous letter and wonders about Tanveer's involvement in it.

episodesList.title: Episode 344
episodesList.summary: Zoya receives another anonymous note about her father. Meanwhile, Najma goes to the Qureshi residence, and Sameera hides from her. Najma finds the house in a disorganised state.

episodesList.title: Episode 345
episodesList.summary: Tanveer decorates the house for Asad and Zoya's 'Walima'. Haseena stops Najma from telling Nikhat's truth to Asad and Dilshad. Thereafter, Haider takes Humeira back to her house.

episodesList.title: Episode 346
episodesList.summary: Humeira returns home and apologises to Gaffur. Haseena manages to manipulate Asad and Dilshad. Zoya thinks that Tanveer is not responsible for sending her the unnamed letters.

episodesList.title: Episode 347
episodesList.summary: Asad and Zoya's romantic moments end when Zoya's pizza gets delivered. Thereafter, Najma calls a mental asylum and asks about Nikhat. Later, Najma looks for Nikhat's dupatta.

episodesList.title: Episode 348
episodesList.summary: Zoya attempts to repair Asad's car but damages it further by pulling out a wire. Thereafter, Razia criticises Zoya's clothes. Later, Nikhat meets Najma at the mental asylum.

episodesList.title: Episode 349
episodesList.summary: In a bid to win a challenge, Zoya prepares biryani for Asad with Haider's help. However, Humeira is upset to see Zoya hugging Haider. Later, Zoya calls Asad for dinner.

episodesList.title: Episode 350
episodesList.summary: Zoya finds a letter that promises to deliver the last part of her father's photograph to her. Later, Haider arranges a romantic dinner for Humeira and promises to marry her.

episodesList.title: Episode 351
episodesList.summary: Zoya finds a letter which promises her the final part of the photograph. Upon reaching the mentioned place, she finds another note, which leads her to the storeroom.

episodesList.title: Episode 352
episodesList.summary: Razia is about to stab Zoya when she sees that Gaffur is not recognisable from the photograph. Later, Haider overhears Gaffur praying to a saint for Zoya's happiness.

episodesList.title: Episode 353
episodesList.summary: Haider dallies with the decision on whether to tell Zoya about the identity of her father or not. Later, Tanveer slits her wrist in a desperate attempt to prove her innocence.

episodesList.title: Episode 354
episodesList.summary: Zoya tries to make a deal with Tanveer, who is adamant about being with Asad. Later, Haider threatens Gaffur, but Humeira makes out that he is talking about their marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 355
episodesList.summary: Asad finds Zoya worrying about Tanveer and comforts her. Further, Tanveer is successful in keeping Asad away from Zoya. Later, Tanveer swears to destroy Razia, Gaffur, and Zoya.

episodesList.title: Episode 356
episodesList.summary: Asad successfully gets Zoya out of the room. Further, Humeira tells Gaffur that she has called the 'maulvi' to marry Haider. Farhan flirts with Khushboo in Sameera's absence.

episodesList.title: Episode 357
episodesList.summary: Gaffur and Razia know Haider's motive behind marrying Humeira. Badi Bi and others congratulate Humeira and Haider. Later, Farhan plans to reveal Khushboo's secret.

episodesList.title: Episode 358
episodesList.summary: Tanveer invites everyone to a feast on the occasion of Humeira's wedding. Farhan thinks Khushboo to be Nikhat and puts her to the test. Zoya abducts Tanveer and ties her up.

episodesList.title: Episode 359
episodesList.summary: Zoya insists Tanveer reveal her father's name to her. Further, Gaffur closely keeps an eye on Haider. Later, Sameera invites Khushboo for a kitty party to reveal her identity.

episodesList.title: Episode 360
episodesList.summary: Humeira gets angry to see Haider getting close to Zoya. Najma reveals about Nikhat to Badi Bi and asks her to keep it a secret. Further, Asad gets shocked to see Zoya's face.

episodesList.title: Episode 361
