episodesList.summary: Humeira asks Haider for a gift on their wedding night. Khushboo tells Farhan and his family that a girl had called asking for Nikhat. Later, Khushboo fears being hypnotised.

episodesList.title: Episode 362
episodesList.summary: Zoya thinks of her father's portrayal. Gaffur asks a weeping Humeira about her worries, but she refuses to share. Arti hypnotises and asks Khushboo her real name and motive.

episodesList.title: Episode 363
episodesList.summary: Badi Bi decides to stay at Farhan's house until Nikhat recovers. Later, Tanveer asks Razia to ally with her. Gaffur and Zoya's picture falls from Tanveer's hand, and Zoya sees it.

episodesList.title: Episode 364
episodesList.summary: Zoya does not recognise her own photograph with Gaffur. Zoya chides Tanveer and also forbids her from entering her room. Later, Gaffur denies having to attend Zoya's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 365
episodesList.summary: Zoya does not recognise her own photograph with Gaffur. Zoya chides Tanveer and also forbids her from entering her room. Later, Gaffur denies having to attend Zoya's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 366
episodesList.summary: Razia agrees with Tanveer to kill Gaffur. Zoya learns that Gaffur had been abroad during her brth. Gaffur promises Zoya that she will meet her father at her reception.

episodesList.title: Episode 367
episodesList.summary: Sameera tries to get a hold of Nikhat, but Badi Bi saves her. Later, when Zeenat sends Zoya her childhood's picture, Zoya realises that she has seen her picture with Gaffur before.

episodesList.title: Episode 368
episodesList.summary: Gaffur decides to divide his property between his daughters. Further, when everyone gets tensed about Rashid's memory loss, the doctor assures them of his recuperation.

episodesList.title: Episode 369
episodesList.summary: Razia asks Gaffur to reveal his identity to Zoya. Gaffur asks Zoya t come to the 'dargah'. Later, Tanveer decides to use her trump card. Farhan fails to obtain Nikhat's property.

episodesList.title: Episode 370
episodesList.summary: Zoya realises that Gaffur is her father. Gaffur pledges to reveal everything to Zoya. Meanwhile, Razia aims to shoot Gaffur. Later, Tanveer decides to use her trump card.

episodesList.title: Episode 371
episodesList.summary: Zoya informs Asad about meeting her father. Asad and the family find Rashid to be murdered. Moreover, Asad accuses Gaffur of killing Rashid, but Zoya refuses to believe it.

episodesList.title: Episode 372
episodesList.summary: Tanveer enjoys her triumph in killing Rashid and framing Gaffur for the crime. On Zoya's request, Gaffur denies the charges against him but asks the police to take him away.

episodesList.title: Episode 373
episodesList.summary: Haider tries to console an upset Zoya, and he tells her to listen to her heart. A mournful Shireen refuses to talk to Dilshad. Further, Haseena finds Nikhat at Rashid's funeral.

episodesList.title: Episode 374
episodesList.summary: Shireen and Dilshad sort out their differences, and the former plans to live with the family. Later, Haider burns a photograph out of hatred, which could prove Gaffur's innocence.

episodesList.title: Episode 375
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Farhan and his family for their actions. Haider and Humeira reconcile their differences. Further, Asad says that he will part with Zoya if she supports Gaffur.

episodesList.title: Episode 376
episodesList.summary: Zoya tells Asad about doubting Tanveer. Haider reveals that Gaffur is innocent and shows the photograph to Asad and Zoya. Later, Zoya decides to put up an act in front of Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 377
episodesList.summary: Zoya and Asad reconcile their differences. Razia threatens Tanveer for trying to gain Gaffur's property. Further, Tanveer falls for Asad and Zoya's trap and promises to help Asad.

episodesList.title: Episode 378
episodesList.summary: Shireen blesses Najma and her unborn baby. Tanveer realises Zoya's ploy and puts up an act in front of Asad. Later, Tanveer wants to marry Asad ad gives him 24 hours to decide.

episodesList.title: Episode 379
episodesList.summary: While Tanveer is away shopping with Razia, Humeira and Zoya gather evidence against her. Later, Razia blackmails Tanveer, saying that she has evidence that could ruin her.

episodesList.title: Episode 380
episodesList.summary: Razia elicits a confession out of Tanveer. Thereafter, Tanveer tries to kill Razia, who is rescued by Zoya. Later, Razia says that she has recorded Tanveer's confession.

episodesList.title: Episode 381
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Tanveer after Zoya produces evidence against her. Thereafter, Asad brings home Gaffur, who is grateful for the bail. Later, he owns up to his guilt.

episodesList.title: Episode 382
episodesList.summary: Zoya wants to sever all ties with Gaffur. Thereafter, Razia tells Gaffur that he has saved her dignity. Later, Zoya's mood lifts up when she watches her childhood video with Haider.

episodesList.title: Episode 383
episodesList.summary: Tanveer swears revenge on Zoya. Thereafter, Nikhat visits Farhan in prison and demands that he sign the divorce papers. Later, Tanveer approaches Nikhat's unattended car.

episodesList.title: Episode 384
episodesList.summary: Humeira and Haider exchange regards with Asad and Zoya on a video call. Later, Tanveer lurks around the house and seizes an opportunity to kill Najma and Gaffur.

episodesList.title: Episode 385
episodesList.summary: Tanveer brutally stabs Asad and Zoya and is about to set them on fire. Later, Dilshad is horrified to see Tanveer stabbing Asad, and she runs away with Sanam and Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 386
episodesList.summary: Sanam manages her 'dhaba', dealing with cranky customers and small mishaps. Thereafter, Aahil conducts a meeting with a client. Later, a relative teases Sanam about Anwar.

episodesList.title: Episode 387
episodesList.summary: Aahil asks Haya, who is physically challenged, to move from his way. When Haya does not respond, Aahil speeds his car. Later, Sanam gets surprised to see Aahil's actions.

episodesList.title: Episode 388
episodesList.summary: Aahil blames Simran as the car gets stuck in the mud. He goes to call the mechanic. Further, Haya puts a dupatta over Sanam's head while Sanam shares her feelings with Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 389
episodesList.summary: Aahil informs Rehan that he has finalised the deal. Further, Aahil comes to Sanam's 'dhaba' and orders her to get the best meal. Later, Aahil burns down Sanam's 'dhaba'.

episodesList.title: Episode 390
episodesList.summary: Aahil gets angry with the truck driver for conning a little boy. Further, the driver asks Aahil to compensate for his loss. Later, everyone celebrates Sanam's 'mehendi'.

episodesList.title: Episode 391
episodesList.summary: Aahil gets stressed to see a man hitting himself, which reminds him of his childhood. Further, when Sanam signs the paper for the loan, Anwar also gives his house as mortgage.

episodesList.title: Episode 392
episodesList.summary: Anwar leaves from the wedding and shocks everyone. Sanam breaks down to hear Anwar's rejection. Further, Sanam rushes to the bus stop and tries to stop Anwar, but he ignores her.

episodesList.title: Episode 393
episodesList.summary: Aahil beats a waiter after seeing a bad dream. Further, moneylenders come to Sanam's place and ask Dilshad to return their money. Sanam gives them a fitting reply.

episodesList.title: Episode 394
episodesList.summary: Aahil desperately waits for his mother's call. Further, Sanam writes a letter to Dilshad, telling her that she is leaving for Bhopal. Later, Aahil meets his mother in jail.

episodesList.title: Episode 395
episodesList.summary: Dilshad gets upset when she finds out that Sanam has gone to Bhopal. Elsewhere, Sanam gets a job as a waitress but gets fired because of Aahil's complaint.

episodesList.title: Episode 396
episodesList.summary: Sanam reaches Aahil's house while following Anwar. Meanwhile, Asma and Azhar's alliance gets fixed. Thereafter, Gazalla hires Sanam as a cook.

episodesList.title: Episode 397
episodesList.summary: Sanam finds out that she is working in Aahil's house and covers her face when she goes in front of him. Later, she accidentally slips and falls in Aahil's arms.

episodesList.title: Episode 398
episodesList.summary: Dilshad feels unwell, and Sanam calls her. Sanam tells her about her new job. Elsewhere, Rehan is concerned about Aahil's safety because of a business controversy.

episodesList.title: Episode 399
episodesList.summary: Aahil comes home drunk and assumes that Sanam is his girlfriend. He tries to undress her but gets interrupted by a call. Later, he finds out that Sanam was in his room last night.

episodesList.title: Episode 400
episodesList.summary: Sanam's face is revealed to Aahil, and he asks her if she intends to seek revenge on him. Sanam tells him that she has found another job and will leave his house in the morning.

episodesList.title: Episode 401
episodesList.summary: The press reporters question Aahil about his picture with a girl. Aahil tells them that it's Sanam. Moreover, Sanam loses her new job. Later, she rebukes Aahil for defaming her.

episodesList.title: Episode 402
episodesList.summary: On Aahil's instructions, a goon follows Sanam. Dilshad comes to Bhopal and gets a heart attack. Later, the doctor asks Sanam to deposit money for her operation.

episodesList.title: Episode 403
episodesList.summary: Sanam enquires the nurse about the person who has paid for Dilshad's operation. The nurse shows her the news on television where she sees Aahil and Rehan.

episodesList.title: Episode 404
episodesList.summary: Sanam reaches Aahil’s house to thank Rehan but avoids meeting him since he is with Aahil. Afterwards, the doctor advises Sanam not to let Dilshad travel.

episodesList.title: Episode 405
episodesList.summary: Dilshad takes shelter at Munisa’s residence. Later, Sanam thanks Rehan and expresses how much she loathes Aahil. However, Aahil arrives during their conversation and hears her.

episodesList.title: Episode 406
episodesList.summary: Rehan advises Sanam to apologise to Aahil. She follows his advice, but Aahil refuses to accept her apology. Further, he asks her to do chores at his house to pay off the debt.

episodesList.title: Episode 407
episodesList.summary: Sanam helps Nazia gain consciousness. However, Aahil tells her to stay away from Nazia. Afterwards, Aahil challenges Sanam to fetch his watch from a pool of water.

episodesList.title: Episode 408
episodesList.summary: Following Shazia’s direction, Sanam puts a steel container in the oven which causes it to catch fire. Sanam tries to put out the fire but gets her hand burnt during the process.

episodesList.title: Episode 409
episodesList.summary: Despite having a fever, Sanam agrees to assist Aahil at his office. When Sanam accidentally drops coffee on Aahil's documents, he punishes her.

episodesList.title: Episode 410
episodesList.summary: Sanam faints and sleeps through the night in Aahil's arms after he takes her into his office. The next day, Sanam puts Aahil's jacket in the washing machine without water.

episodesList.title: Episode 411
episodesList.summary: Sanam succeeds in Aahil's task to make 100 kg 'laddoos', but Gazalla and Razaq steal two boxes of 'laddoos' without Sanam's knowledge. Later, Shoaib makes Haya feel uncomfortable.

episodesList.title: Episode 412
episodesList.summary: When Aahil realises that Sanam is going to win the task, he cheats to make Sanam lose. Aahil then asks Sanam to apologise. Later, Munisa makes Dilshad and Haya do the housework.

episodesList.title: Episode 413
episodesList.summary: Asma secretly helps Sanam find out Aahil's foul play. Sanam denounces Aahil's deed. Later, Rahat gazes at Haya. Further, Gazalla stops Sanam from moving towards the forbidden room.

episodesList.title: Episode 414
episodesList.summary: While everyone waits for Azhar, he plays cards with his friends. Tanveer, who is addressed as Begum, arrives at the party. Later, Dilshad is shocked to learn where Sanam works.

episodesList.title: Episode 415
episodesList.summary: Aahil remembers his scarred childhood. Further, Azhar and Asma's engagement takes place. Later, Sanam forces Dilshad to come inside the 'Haveli', much to the latter's dismay.

episodesList.title: Episode 416
episodesList.summary: Dilshad remembers how Tanveer killed Najma, Asad and Zoya at the 'Haveli'. Sanam figures out that Tanveer is blind. Further, Tanveer tells Aahil to live his life on his own terms.

episodesList.title: Episode 417
episodesList.summary: After saving Haya, when Rahat chides her, Dilshad informs him that Haya is deaf and dumb. Further, Sanam unlocks the forbidden room, but Lateef does not let her enter the room.

episodesList.title: Episode 418
episodesList.summary: Munisa slaps Haya and accuses her of theft. Thereafter, Begum avoids Sanam's queries regarding the forbidden room. Later, Masood and his men plant a bomb in Aahil's room.

episodesList.title: Episode 419
episodesList.summary: The terrorists capture the bungalow and threaten to kill everyone. Aahil and Sanam manage to save everyone from the attack. When Sanam finds Badi Bi, she tries to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 420
episodesList.summary: On Rehaan and others' urging, Tanveer and Aahil entrust Sanam with Badi Ammi's responsibility. Later, Gazalla and Tanveer intentionally give wrong medicines to Sanam for Badi Ammi.

episodesList.title: Episode 421
episodesList.summary: Tanveer goes to meet Dilshad and Haya. Badi Ammi falls sick after consuming the wrong medicines, and Aahil admonishes Sanam. Later, Tanveer asks Gazalla and Razaq to be careful.

episodesList.title: Episode 422
episodesList.summary: Tanveer threatens Badi Ammi with a snake for the whereabouts of the property papers. Further, Sanam saves Badi Ammi from the snake, and Rehaan praises her courageous act.

episodesList.title: Episode 423
episodesList.summary: A jealous Munisa throws away Haya's food and asks Rahat to stay away from Haya. Later, Badi Ammi tries to talk to Sanam, and an elated Sanam informs Tanveer about the improvement.

episodesList.title: Episode 424
episodesList.summary: Tanveer threatens Badi Ammi about the property papers. When Munisa goes to visit her friend, Shoaib misbehaves with Haya. Later, a distressed Haya bangs on Rahat's door for help.

episodesList.title: Episode 425
episodesList.summary: On her way back, Sanam is followed by Tanveer's men. Rahat saves Haya from Shoaib and throws him out of the house. Further, Badi Ammi asks Sanam to visit a graveyard alone.

episodesList.title: Episode 426
episodesList.summary: Sanam visits the graveyard and finds the box, which contains the will. Tanveer's men catch hold of Sanam, and Tanveer orders them to kill her. Later, Sanam loses her consciousness.

episodesList.title: Episode 427
episodesList.summary: After miscreants bury Sanam alive, Tanveer procures Nawab's will from them. Thereafter, Tanveer calls Rehaan to the graveyard. Later, Aahil reaches the graveyard to rescue Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 428
episodesList.summary: Aahil rescues Sanam from a grave and drives her home. Meanwhile, Tanveer reveals secrets to Rehaan and hands him a will. Later, Tanveer wonders where Sanam has hidden the will.

episodesList.title: Episode 429
episodesList.summary: Aahil and Rahat take care of Sanam and Haya. Thereafter, Tanveer instructs Gazalla and Razaq to procure Nawab's will while Sanam is unconscious and dares them to mess up.

episodesList.title: Episode 430
episodesList.summary: Eager to take over Nawab's property, Tanveer calls in the lawyer. However, things go awry for her as the lawyer declares that Aahil is the rightful owner of the property.

episodesList.title: Episode 431
episodesList.summary: Tanveer coaxes Aahil into marrying so that he owns the property. Meanwhile, at Munisa's home, Rahat is furious with Haya for changing the decor of his room and throws her out.

episodesList.title: Episode 432
episodesList.summary: Aahil is lost in thoughts and is unwilling to marry, despite Tanveer's coaxing. Later, when Nida gives Sanam clothes to wash, Sanam returns her tips and gives her a dressing down.

episodesList.title: Episode 433
episodesList.summary: Rahat repairs Haya's flower pots to make up for his misbehaviour. Later, a frustrated Aahil proposes Nida for marriage as Sanam does not express any feeling towards him.

episodesList.title: Episode 434
episodesList.summary: Nida accepts Aahil's proposal for marriage, and the couple gets engaged at Aahil's house. Meanwhile, Haya leaves a leter for Rahat, requesting to join everyone at dinner.

episodesList.title: Episode 435
episodesList.summary: A drunk Aahil blames Sanam for not understanding him. Further, Rahat surprises Munisa by joining Haya for dinner. Later, Rehaan asks Tanveer not to force Aahil to marry Nida.

episodesList.title: Episode 436
episodesList.summary: Nida tells Gazalla and Razaq that no one can stop her from marrying Aahil. Rehaan thinks of Sanam and gets interrupted by Aahil. Later, Rehaan offers a lift to Haya and Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 437
episodesList.summary: Gazalla hides the dupatta under the bed, but Tanveer picks it up from the floor. Further, Rahat accepts Haya's gift and wears it. Later, Rahat scolds Haya for taking him outside.

episodesList.title: Episode 438
episodesList.summary: When Nida blames Sanam for stealing the dupatta, Tanveer defends her. Further, Haya worries about Dilshad's return. Later, Aahil tries to stop Rehaan from going with Sanam alone.

episodesList.title: Episode 439
episodesList.summary: Sanam and Rehaan go to the 'dargah', and Aahil looks at Sanam praying in the 'dargah'. Further, Rahat saves Haya from an accident. Aahil and Sanam tie a thread at the 'dargah'.

episodesList.title: Episode 440
episodesList.summary: Haya enquires Rahat about his fear of the outside world. Further, Nida purposely falls to seek Aahil's attention. Later, Nida shows a shortcut to Sanam to lead her astray.

episodesList.title: Episode 441
episodesList.summary: Sanam, who is trapped inside the laundry machine, screams for help. Further, Rahat takes Haya home. Later, Rehaan notices the broker and enquires him about Sanam's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Episode 442
episodesList.summary: Sanam stops Aahil, who leaves her alone in the farmhouse. Munisa throws Rahat's invitation card into the dustbin. Later, Aahil notices Sanam and Rehaan hugging each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 443
episodesList.summary: Rehaan adorns Sanam's hair with 'gajra', and Aahil feels jealous. Later, the henna meant for Nida accidentally falls down and splashes across Sanam's palms.

episodesList.title: Episode 444
episodesList.summary: Nida leaves Aahil's house because Aahil refuses to fire Sanam. Further, Nida knows about Tanveer's plan and asks her for INR 5 crores in exchange for marrying Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 445
episodesList.summary: Aahil hears Rehaan talking to himself and learns that he loves Sanam. Elsewhere, Nida plans to acquire Aahil's properties and poisons Tanveer's soup.

episodesList.title: Episode 446
episodesList.summary: Tanveer realises that Nida tried to kill her and decides to find another bride for Aahil. Meanwhile, Rehaan tells Dilshad that he wants to marry Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 447
episodesList.summary: Rehaan tells Tanveer that he wants to marry Sanam. Meanwhile, Sanam decides to leave the job. Later, Tanveer meets Dilshad and tells her that she wants Sanam to marry Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 448
episodesList.summary: Dilshad suffers from a heart attack. Tanveer offers to pay for her treatment and wishes to marry Sanam off to Aahil. Later, Rehaan tells Aahil that he plans to propose to Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 449
episodesList.summary: There is a terrorist attack at the party, and Rahat rescues Haya. Elsewhere, Tanveer asks Sanam to marry Aahil. She also tells her that she can divorce him after three months.

episodesList.title: Episode 450
episodesList.summary: Tanveer ties up Nida. Meanwhile, Sanam takes Nida's place as the bride and agrees to marry Aahil. Later, Tanveer tries to convince Aahil to marry Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 451
episodesList.summary: Tanveer makes Aahil marry Sanam. Consequently, Rehaan's dream of marrying Sanam gets shattered. Later, Tanveer makes Aahil think that Sanam has married him for his money.

episodesList.title: Episode 452
episodesList.summary: Rehaan decides to leave the house, but Tanveer convinces him otherwise. Meanwhile, Aahil confronts Sanam about marrying him for money. Rahat and Haya leave for home.

episodesList.title: Episode 453
episodesList.summary: Tanveer asks Lateef to plan for 'iftar'. Further, she asks Aahil to submit his marriage certificate to the lawyer. Later, Sanam and Aahil feed each other to break their fast.

episodesList.title: Episode 454
episodesList.summary: Rahat finds a note from Dilshad at her residence. Meanwhile, Tanveer encounters an occultist. Later, Rahat is interrupted by Sanam when he is about to express his feelings to Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 455
episodesList.summary: Rahat and Haya reach the hospital to see Dilshad. Gazalla informs the lawyer about Sanam and Aahil sleeping in separate rooms. Later, the lawyer reaches Aahil's residence.

episodesList.title: Episode 456
episodesList.summary: Aahil makes the lawyer believe that he loves Sanam. Aahil asks Sanam to sleep in his room to avoid people tattling about their marriage. Later, Rahat confronts Munisa.

episodesList.title: Episode 457
episodesList.summary: Tanveer’s guests argue that Sanam’s family’s stature is not as high as Aahil’s. Sanam replies that her father had been a successful businessman before he and her mother had died.

episodesList.title: Episode 458
episodesList.summary: The occultist warns Tanveer that her death is near. Further, Rahat introduces Haya to his brother, Faiz, and the two recognise each other from their earlier encounter on the road.

episodesList.title: Episode 459
episodesList.summary: Rahat and Faiz both like Haya. Meanwhile, Aahil makes Sanam wear the other set of bangles, much to Rehaan's dismay. Later, Tanveer invites an unknown lady for the 'Dawaat-e-Eid'.

episodesList.title: Episode 460
episodesList.summary: Tanveer is shocked to know that Sanam is Asad and Zoya's daughter. Further, Sanam asks Aahil to quit drinking. Later, Tanveer agrees to let Razia stay at the 'Haveli' and aid her.

episodesList.title: Episode 461
episodesList.summary: Tanveer is impolite towards Sanam. Further, as Sanam asks Tanveer and Razia about her parents, they lie to her. Later, Tanveer pays Razia to hide the truth from Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 462
episodesList.summary: Aahil gets jealous to see Rehaan touch Sanam. Further, Aahil hurts Sanam while dancing. Later, Aahil refuses to drink with his friends. Later, Sanam finds a secret door.

episodesList.title: Episode 463
episodesList.summary: Sanam and Rehaan enter Zoya and Asad's room, but Tanveer forbids them from entering the room again. Later, when Shoaib returns, Munisa tells Rahat that she owns the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 464
episodesList.summary: Sanam spots the locket but does not open it. Tanveer gets Zoya and Asad's room sealed. Meanwhile, Rahat, Faiz and Haya leave Munisa's house. Later, Tanveer fails to kill Dilshad.

episodesList.title: Episode 465
episodesList.summary: Rehaan tells Sanam that Asad was an opulent business person. Aahil sees Sanam hold Rehaan's hand. Later, Razia is unable to kill Dilshad as Dilshad is released? from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Episode 466
episodesList.summary: Sanam tells Lateef about a strange body ache that she often undergoes. Sanam learns that her parents did not die in a road accident. Later, Tanveer throws Razia out of the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 467
episodesList.summary: Sanam informs Aahil about her parents' death. Faiz tells Rahat about his feelings for Haya, which leaves Rahat shocked. Further, Tanveer asks Razia to stay in the servant's room.

episodesList.title: Episode 468
episodesList.summary: Sanam tells Tanveer about her parents' death, which shocks her. Haya mistakenly agrees to marry Faiz. Later, Tanveer worries about any survivors from the attack on Asad's family.

episodesList.title: Episode 469
episodesList.summary: At night, Seher cons a man on the road for money. Faiz asks Haya about her wishes for the wedding. Later, Seher talks to Tanveer, who finds the former's voice similar to Sanam's.

episodesList.title: Episode 470
episodesList.summary: Sunehri plans to con a rich man for money. Sanam learns about Haya's wedding, and Aahil agrees to attend the wedding. Further, Sunehri reaches Aahil's house to con Aahil's guests.

episodesList.title: Episode 471
episodesList.summary: Sunehri dons the look of Sheikh's wife and enters the bungalow. Sunehri plans to steal the necklace that Sheikh gave to Sanam. Later, Sunehri steals the necklace from the locker.

episodesList.title: Episode 472
episodesList.summary: Sunehri's burqa gets torn accidentally, while she tries to escape. Aahil spots Sunehri and assumes her to be Sanam. Further, Rahat asks Haya if she is happy with her wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 473
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells everyone about the necklace and accuses Sanam of taking it. Aahil takes Sanam's side, and she thanks him. Later, Aahil is upset to see Sanam and Rehaan together.

episodesList.title: Episode 474
episodesList.summary: Sanam and Aahil argue with each other. Tanveer desires to kill Dilshad during the wedding. Further, Haya is married off to Faiz and is stunned to see that Rahat is not the groom.

episodesList.title: Episode 475
episodesList.summary: Tanveer plants a gas vial in Dilshad's room to kill her. Dilshad is unable to escape because of physical inabilities. Later, Rahat brings Haya to Faiz before leaving for his job.

episodesList.title: Episode 476
episodesList.summary: When the vial explodes, and Aahil is fatally wounded, Sanam brings him to a hospital. Later, security guards chase Seher, who has stolen jewellery and money, to the same hospital.

episodesList.title: Episode 477
episodesList.summary: Seher donates blood to Dilshad in the hospital to hide from the guards, who are chasing her. Later, while Sanam prays to God, Seher discovers that she is her lookalike.

episodesList.title: Episode 478
episodesList.summary: Aahil wants to return home from the hospital as soon as he regains consciousness. Later, Seher tries to dupe a rich and childless couple at a cafe, but Rehaan interrupts her.

episodesList.title: Episode 479
episodesList.summary: Seher runs away from Rehaan somehow and hides behind his car. Meanwhile, Salima arrives at Aahil's house and rebukes him for marrying a deaf and mute girl like Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 480
episodesList.summary: Sanam falls in Rehaan's arms, and Aahil misunderstands him, which results in a confrontation between them. Faiz pretends before Salima that his conjugal life is running smoothly.

episodesList.title: Episode 481
episodesList.summary: Aahil wants to send Rehaan away on a project to prevent him from meeting Sanam. Meanwhile, Salima finds out that Faiz had been acting and that his conjugal life does not exist.

episodesList.title: Episode 482
episodesList.summary: Tanveer comes to Aahil's room and says that the property papers are ready for signing. However, Aahil cannot sign due to severe pain in his hand. Later, Rehaan runs over Seher.

episodesList.title: Episode 483
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells Sanam that she has decided to send Dilshad to Shimla. Further, Sanam helps Aahil to change the bandage. Later, Tanveer belittles Sanam for winning the competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 484
episodesList.summary: Rehaan gets irritated by Sunehri's gibberish talk. While Dilshad leaves for Shimla, Haya and Tanveer bid her goodbye. Further, Aahil and Sanam participate in the competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 485
episodesList.summary: Aahil gets mesmerised to look at Sanam. Tanveer gets surprised to learn that Aahil and Sanam won the compatibility test. Later, Rehaan scolds Sunehri for her drama.

episodesList.title: Episode 486
episodesList.summary: Tanveer decides to keep a close eye on Razia. Further, Sunehri asks Rehaan to hire her as his secretary. Later, Aahil and Sanam spend quality time with each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 487
episodesList.summary: A killer informs Tanveer that Dilshad fled after the accident. Further, Sunehri tries to open the safe but stops to hear footsteps. Later, Sanam swears to know about Aahil's past.

episodesList.title: Episode 488
episodesList.summary: Phupi searches Haya's room to find out about her lover. Further, when Sunehri talks to Rehaan, he gets charmed by her. Later, Phupi decides to plot against Haya to evict her.

episodesList.title: Episode 489
episodesList.summary: Rehaan asks Sunehri to accompany him to a meeting. Sanam learns that Razia's cousin is suffering from paralysis. Later, Rehaan sees a dead man lying on the road.

episodesList.title: Episode 490
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells Aahil to get the divorce papers from the lawyer. Further, Razia tells Dilshad that she will destroy Tanveer. Later, Sunehri tries to steal money from the safe.

episodesList.title: Episode 491
episodesList.summary: Salma creates a misunderstanding between Haya and Faiz's director, due to which the director feels offended. Tanveer collides with Dilshad and asks Aahil to find out who it was.

episodesList.title: Episode 492
episodesList.summary: Sunehri decorates Rehaan's room on his birthday. Elsewhere, Tanveer recalls how she had shot Raza and made Aahil believe that he did it. Later, Sanam finds a whip in the attic.

episodesList.title: Episode 493
episodesList.summary: Faiz rebukes Haya, and she calls Rahat. Elsewhere, Sunehri feels reluctant to steal money from Rehaan. Later, Tanveer warns Aahil that Sanam is trying to look into his past.

episodesList.title: Episode 494
episodesList.summary: Rozy and Shishupal come to Rehaan's house. Elsewhere, Aahil asks Sanam to stop prying into his past. Further, he notices the whip in his room and gets agitated.

episodesList.title: Episode 495
episodesList.summary: Faiz divorces Haya, while Shishupal imprints Rehaan's locker key. Later, Tanveer finds out that Aahil got the property papers two days ago and gets angry as he did not inform her.

episodesList.title: Episode 496
episodesList.summary: Rahat comes back home. Shishupal and Rozy plan to rob Rehaan's house. Later, Razaq and Gazalla accidentally mix the contents of Razia's packet in an apple pie, and Aahil eats it.

episodesList.title: Episode 497
episodesList.summary: Aahil and Sanam start singing and dancing, while Dilshad falls asleep. Meanwhile, Sunehri notices that Rehaan has an additional key of the safe.

episodesList.title: Episode 498
episodesList.summary: Rehaan tells Sunehri that Tanveer never loved him. Meanwhile, Aahil tells Sanam about his past. Later, Haya tells Rahat that he is not strong enough to love anybody.

episodesList.title: Episode 499
episodesList.summary: Bhaktivash Devi, an occultist, asks Razia to bring her 100 flowers. Meanwhile, Rozy and Shishupal ask Sunehri to help them steal. Later, Sanam helps Aahil cope with his past.

episodesList.title: Episode 500
episodesList.summary: Tanveer scolds Gazalla and Razaq for failing to hamper Sanam and Aahil's relationship. Meanwhile, Faiz learns about Phupi's plot to turn him against Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 501
episodesList.summary: Devi asks Razia to bring her the hair of a genderless person as the second task of her test. Faiz requests Rahat to marry Haya. Rehaan tells Sunehri that he loves her.

episodesList.title: Episode 502
episodesList.summary: Haya accepts Rahat’s marriage proposal. Sunehri is furious with Shishupal and Rozy and kicks them out of Rehaan's house. Tanveer urges Aahil and Sanam to sign the property papers.

episodesList.title: Episode 503
episodesList.summary: Tanveer manipulates Aahil into thinking that he can never be a good husband and that his relationship with Sanam will not last. Rahat tells Faiz that Haya is ready to marry him.

episodesList.title: Episode 504
episodesList.summary: Sanam refuses to sign the property papers without Aahil. She suspects Tanveer when her story about Aahil killing his father does not match with the story that Aahil had told her.

episodesList.title: Episode 505
episodesList.summary: Sanam steals the property documents from Tanveer's room. Meanwhile, the police arrive at Rehaan's place to arrest Sunehri while he proposes her for marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 506
episodesList.summary: Devi tells Razia where to find Sunehri. Tanveer asks Sanam to sign the papers, but she refuses by saying that her hand is wounded. Faiz apologises to Haya for misunderstanding her.

episodesList.title: Episode 507
episodesList.summary: Razia wants Sunehri to work for her. Meanwhile, Haya asks Rahat about his conversation with Faiz. Tanveer, Gazalla and Razaq resort to violence to get Sanam's thumb impression.

episodesList.title: Episode 508
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells Sanam that she will be bound to sign the documents and also make Aahil sign them. Razia tells Dilshad that she has found Seher. Aahil decides to apologise to Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 509
episodesList.summary: Dilshad is fearful of Razia and tries to inform Sanam about her. Meanwhile, Rahat and Haya go to a resort. Razia and Sunehri meet at a temple. Later, Rehaan visits the temple.

episodesList.title: Episode 510
episodesList.summary: Sanam is on her way to an event in Kohinoor hotel with Dilshad stuck behind her car. Rahat and Haya's car breaks down while going to the event. Tanveer and Aahil go to the event.

episodesList.title: Episode 511
episodesList.summary: Tanveer praises Aahil for establishing the hotel. Later, Sanam fails to talk to Aahil. Rehaan takes a veiled Dilshad inside the venue. Later, Razia tells Sunehri to hide her face.

episodesList.title: Episode 512
episodesList.summary: Dilshad comes in close contact with Sanam, Sunehri and Haya. However, the three fail to see each other at the same time. Later, Sanam tells Haya to bring Aahil to the corridor.

episodesList.title: Episode 513
episodesList.summary: Tanveer threatens to kill Aahil if Sanam tells him her truth and stops him from signing the property papers. Further, Aahil assures Sanam that their love will never change.

episodesList.title: Episode 514
episodesList.summary: Razia replaces Sanam with Sunehri, and Tanveer attempts to stab Sanam. However, she gets hurt instead. Thereafter, Sanam tries to reach out to Aahil but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 515
episodesList.summary: Dilshad attempts to rescue Sanam, but Razia stops her. Seher enters the house as Sanam and has some recollections of the past. Sanam is not scared of Tanveer's threats.

episodesList.title: Episode 516
episodesList.summary: Tanveer has changed the clauses of the property papers. Rahat tells Faiz to drop his plan of marrying Haya. Meanwhile, Sunehri plans to hurt Tanveer but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 517
episodesList.summary: Aahil thinks that Sanam is purposely being a tease. Haya is upset about Rahat's departure to the army. Later, when Sanam searches for a room to sleep, she has a blurry vision.

episodesList.title: Episode 518
episodesList.summary: Sanam spends the night at Gazalla and Razaq's room. Haya is confused about Faiz' actions. The next day, Aahil gifts Sanam a ring. Further, Sanam's plan to hurt Tanveer fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 519
episodesList.summary: Sunehri finds it difficult to be at peace as Rehaan's memories keep haunting her. While Aahil is excited to celebrate Diwali with Sanam, Tanveer plans to separate them.

episodesList.title: Episode 520
episodesList.summary: Sunehri is at a loss of words as Rehaan expresses the spite he bears for her. Meanwhile, Faiz saves Haya from an accident. Later, Rehaan resists accepting Tanveer's gift.

episodesList.title: Episode 521
episodesList.summary: Sunehri wonders why Razia stopped her from talking to Dilshad. Later, Aahil is shattered as Sanam withdraws herself in spite of his efforts to mend their relationship.

episodesList.title: Episode 522
episodesList.summary: Razaq comes up with a plan to kill Sanam and shares it with Tanveer. Later, Sunehri reads through Razaq and Gazalla's demeanour and tricks Razaq to have the spiked 'falooda'.

episodesList.title: Episode 523
episodesList.summary: Aahil blames Razia from the entire mishap and resolves to send her off to an old age home. Later, Sunehri takes advantage of Aahil's weakness and compels him to change his mind.

episodesList.title: Episode 524
episodesList.summary: Razia manages to save Sanam from getting caught. Further, Razia gives a letter to Sanam. Later, Tanveer gets suspicious after reading the note thrown away by Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 525
episodesList.summary: Gazalla and Razaq plant a spy camera in Sanam’s room. Razia asks Sunehri to get Aahil’s signature on the property papers. Later, Rahat informs Haya that he is going to marry her.

episodesList.title: Episode 526
episodesList.summary: Razia offers to pay Sunehri INR 1.5 crores to marry Aahil, but later Sunehri demands INR 2 crores from her. Thereafter, Tanveer fails to expose Sanam in front of Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 527
episodesList.summary: Razia and Sunehri discuss how they averted getting caught. Further, Rahat tells Faiz that Haya loves him. Later, Faiz swears never to let Haya and Rahat get close to each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 528
episodesList.summary: Faiz learns that Haya loves Rahat. Tanveer plans to get Sanam killed. Razia overhears Tanveer's plan but fails to warn Sunehri about it. Later, Sanam escapes from Razia's men.

episodesList.title: Episode 529
episodesList.summary: Sanam escapes from Razia's men. Tanveer's effort to kill Sunehri fails as Sunehri goes out of service area. Later, Faiz tells Haya that Rahat will divorce her after their wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 530
episodesList.summary: Faiz shows Haya the clip in which Rahat tells Faiz that he will divorce Haya. Further, Haya is able to speak. Sanam's car explodes. Later, Razia again kidnaps Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 531
episodesList.summary: Aahil believes that Sanam is dead, but soon after, he is glad to see that she is alive. Sunehri tells Aahil how she was saved from the blast. Later, Haya returns to marry Rahat.

episodesList.title: Episode 532
episodesList.summary: Sanam hides inside a closet and finds the locket. She sees the picture of her lookalike and questions Razia about Sunehri. Meanwhile, everyone is elated to listen to Haya speak.

episodesList.title: Episode 533
episodesList.summary: Sanam learns about Seher's existence from Razia. Further, Seher stops Tanveer from leaving Haya's wedding. Thereafter, Sanam escapes from Razia's hold and goes to visit Seher.

episodesList.title: Episode 534
episodesList.summary: Sanam meets Seher, but the latter hits her on her head. Razia's men kidnap Sanam from the venue. Further, Aahil informs Tanveer about his desire to marry Sanam at the earliest.

episodesList.title: Episode 535
episodesList.summary: Razia tries to manipulate Sunehri, but Dilshad overhears them. Tanveer plans to destroy Aahil's plans of marrying Sanam. Further, Faiz tries to console a heartbroken Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 536
episodesList.summary: Razia taunts Sanam about Aahil's nuptials with Seher. Rahat asks Haya to trust him, but she refuses to listen. Further, Rehaan feels that Sunehri has disguised herself as Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 537
episodesList.summary: Tanveer gives a dupatta to Sanam to wear during the party. Later, Razia tells Seher about Tanveer's ploy. When Tanveer reveals her plans of killing Sanam, Dilshad overhears her.

episodesList.title: Episode 538
episodesList.summary: Haya wears a western dress to the party and leaves with Faiz. At the party, Sanam wears Tanveer's dupatta. Later, Rahat rescues Haya from the goons, who try to misbehave with her.

episodesList.title: Episode 539
episodesList.summary: Sanam drinks the spiked juice and dances at the party. Faiz and Rahat argue with each other about Haya. Further, Tanveer sets fire to Sanam's dupatta with the desire to kill her.

episodesList.title: Episode 540
episodesList.summary: Tanveer learns that her plans of killing Sanam had failed. Tanveer tries to instigate Aahil against Sanam. Further, Rehaan asks Aahil and Tanveer to find out about the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 541
episodesList.summary: Aahil mistakes Seher for Sanam and asks her if she really loves him. Thereafter, Rahat tries to pacify Haya by talking to her. Later, Tanveer and Seher warn each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 542
episodesList.summary: Sanam fails in her attempt to escape from her captivity and is drugged by the goons. Later, Dilshad reveals her identity to Seher in an attempt to stop her from marrying Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 543
episodesList.summary: Seher tells Dilshad that she knows Razia's den, which should help them find Sanam. Meanwhile, Faiz sabotages Haya and Rahat's relation by drugging Rahat and proving his infidelity.

episodesList.title: Episode 544
episodesList.summary: Seher finally finds Sanam, but a goon hits her from behind, rendering her unconscious. Meanwhile, Tanveer is delighted to hear that Sanam has escaped from the wedding venue.

episodesList.title: Episode 545
episodesList.summary: Seher tells Sanam about their shared family history, and Sanam is shocked to know Tanveer's secrets. Later, Dilshad reaches Razia's den and finds Seher and Sanam detained there.

episodesList.title: Episode 546
episodesList.summary: Razia demands a ransom from Seher to set Sanam free. However, Dilshad and Seher engage in a physical struggle with her. Meanwhile, Tanveer prevents Aahil from unveiling the bride.

episodesList.title: Episode 547
episodesList.summary: After Razia dies from electrocution, Dilshad wishes to visit Asad and Zoya's graves. Later, Aahil delivers a speech to the guests on how Sanam has improved him as a human being.

episodesList.title: Episode 548
episodesList.summary: Dilshad visits Asad and Zoya's graves and talks to them about Sanam and Seher. Meanwhile, Aahil is angry as he finds out that the bride is not Sanam, but an impostor.

episodesList.title: Episode 549
episodesList.summary: Haya imagines Faiz to be Rahat and faints. Tanveer tells Aahil that Sanam used him as a pawn to get the property from him. Later, Aahil misses Sanam and tries to call her.

episodesList.title: Episode 550
episodesList.summary: Aahil calls Sanam disloyal and swears to erase her memories. Further, Haya is shocked to learn that she slept with Faiz. Later, Sanam and Seher swear to take revenge on Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 551
episodesList.summary: A drunk Aahil faints in Nayi Sanam's arms. Further, Tanveer asks Nayi Sanam to learn about Aahil's likes. Later, Haya informs Faiz that she will know about the masked man soon.

episodesList.title: Episode 552
episodesList.summary: Sanam learns that Aahil has married Nayi Sanam. Further, Haya and others watch the CD, but the disc gets corrupted. Later, Razaq and Gazalla throw Sanam out of the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 553
episodesList.summary: Razaq and Gazalla find out that Nayi Sanam helped Sanam, and they blackmail her. Further, Baba predicts that Tanveer will be punished for all her sins, but Tanveer refuses to believe him. Faiz tells Rahat that he won the challenge of taking Haya away from him and asks him to divorce her soon. Afterwards, Tanveer celebrates her victory at Asad and Zoya's cemetery. She admits ruining Sanam's life after doing the same to Zoya. Later, Tanveer gets surprised to find Sanam in the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 554
episodesList.summary: Seher fights back against Tanveer. Further, Sanam hides Seher in a secret room, which belonged to their parents. Later, Sanam threatens Gazalla to stay away from her.

episodesList.title: Episode 555
episodesList.summary: Sanam informs Tanveer that she murdered Aahil's father. Further, a furious Tanveer challenges Sanam that Aahil will evict her in a month, but Sanam swears to punish Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 556
episodesList.summary: Gazalla and Razaq inform Tanveer that her work is done. Further, Rahat learns that the masked man is Faiz himself. Sanam and Seher lose consciousness after eating the food.

episodesList.title: Episode 557
episodesList.summary: Razaq and Gazalla find Seher's body in the corridor. They assume that she is Sanam and bury her in the graveyard. Meanwhile, Rahat tells Haya the truth about Faiz.

episodesList.title: Episode 558
episodesList.summary: Rahat finds out that Faiz tried to rape Haya and has kidnapped her. Elsewhere, Tanveer realises that Sanam is alive and decides to burn her dream house in order to draw her out.

episodesList.title: Episode 559
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam tells Sanam and Seher that she helped them after they were poisoned. Faiz takes Haya to a farmhouse. The police show Rahat, a letter and divorce papers, signed by Haya.

episodesList.title: Episode 560
episodesList.summary: Aahil decides that Sanam will live in his house as a servant. He plans to throw a party to announce that he loves Nayi Sanam. Later, Haya asks Faiz to let her go, but he refuses.

episodesList.title: Episode 561
episodesList.summary: Faiz decides to starve Haya until she agrees to consummate their relationship. He also decides to get rid of Rahat. Later, a dancer comes to Aahil's party.

episodesList.title: Episode 562
episodesList.summary: Faiz tips the police to search for Rahat's car. When they find Haya's clothes there, they arrest Rahat. Elsewhere, Sanam faints after the dance performance, and Aahil holds her.

episodesList.title: Episode 563
episodesList.summary: Faiz shows Haya a video of Rahat getting arrested. Elsewhere, Tanveer asks Aahil to test Sanam by asking her to transfer the property to his name.

episodesList.title: Episode 564
episodesList.summary: Seher replaces Sanam and agrees to sign the property papers. However, Aahil tears off the papers. Meanwhile, Haya pretends to be nice to Faiz in order to win his trust.

episodesList.title: Episode 565
episodesList.summary: Sanam decides to bring Aahil his mother’s favourite plants. Gazalla hires Rafiq to assassinate Sanam. Elsewhere, Haya tries to find a way to inform Rahat that she is alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 566
episodesList.summary: Gazalla and Tanveer try to save Sanam from dying. Meanwhile, Rahat receives Haya’s message from a stranger. Thereafter, he goes to a ‘dargah’, where Haya is expecting him.

episodesList.title: Episode 567
episodesList.summary: Tanveer intentionally falls down the stairs to blame Sanam for it. Meanwhile, Rahat spots Haya and Faiz. Afterwards, Tanveer accuses Sanam of trying to kill her.

episodesList.title: Episode 568
episodesList.summary: Sanam brings milk for Tanveer, who accuses Sanam of trying to poison her. When Aahil assures Tanveer that Sanam is not trying to kill her, Tanveer drinks the milk and faints.

episodesList.title: Episode 569
episodesList.summary: Razaq injects Tanveer with the antidote. Later, Tanveer gains consciousness and manipulates Aahil into believing that Sanam had tried to kill her. Hence, Aahil asks Sanam to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 570
episodesList.summary: Rehaan reveals to Sanam that although he is Tanveer's biological son, she has been treating him like a servant. Aahil vows to Tanveer that he will never look at Sanam's face again.

episodesList.title: Episode 571
episodesList.summary: Rehaan asks Aahil not to get Sanam arrested as the milk that Tanveer had consumed had already been spoiled. At Faiz's residence, Haya attacks Faiz with a knife.

episodesList.title: Episode 572
episodesList.summary: Haya leaves Faiz to die and reaches Rahat's house. A group of surgeons, dressed as clerics, arrive to perform surgery on Tanveer. Sunehri tells Rehaan her New Year's resolution.

episodesList.title: Episode 573
episodesList.summary: Sanam, Seher and Rehaan swap the pieces of jewellery in the box with Rehaan's birth certificate in order to expose Tanveer's true self to Aahil. Later, Haya sees Faiz's ghost.

episodesList.title: Episode 574
episodesList.summary: Haya gets scared to see flames, but Rahat comforts her. Aahil learns that Rehaan is Tanveer's biological son and questions Tanveer. Later, Rahat puts a ring on Haya's finger.

episodesList.title: Episode 575
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells Aahil that she had certain reasons for which she has loved Aahil like her own son and has denied Rehaan a mother's love. Later, Aahil gives Rehaan an amulet.

episodesList.title: Episode 576
episodesList.summary: Haya buys a bouquet of flowers for Rahat. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam sees Aahil and Sanam in an intimate position. Rehaan tells Sunehri that Aahil has organised a function for Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 577
episodesList.summary: Aahil gives a speech, honouring Tanveer. Later, Tanveer looks at Sanam's picture, and the pictures of the people she has killed. She also wonders how she had got her sight back.

episodesList.title: Episode 578
episodesList.summary: Razaq and Gazalla realise that Tanveer can see. Faiz hides in the trunk of Rahat and Haya's car. Meanwhile, both Sanam and Sunehri suspect that Tanveer can see.

episodesList.title: Episode 579
episodesList.summary: Tanveer succeeds in making Sunehri and Rehaan believe that she is blind. Later, Sunehri affectionately asks for Rehaan's forgiveness while Tanveer gets confused to see them.

episodesList.title: Episode 580
episodesList.summary: Sanam reveals Seher's identity to Rahat and Haya. Haya tells Sanam and Seher about 'Neele Chaand Ki Raat', and they get excited. Later, Faiz tries to get back into Haya's life.

episodesList.title: Episode 581
episodesList.summary: Tanveer asks Nayi Sanam to prepare for 'Neele Chaand Ki Raat'. She also sends Aahil and Rehaan to the garden. Faiz reaches Haya's house and has a bite of 'kheer' from her hand.

episodesList.title: Episode 582
episodesList.summary: Tanveer waits for Aahil to catch Sunehri with Rehaan. However, Aahil leaves when Nayi Sanam arrives. Tanveer realises that Seher is alive. Haya is afraid that Faiz might kill her.

episodesList.title: Episode 583
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam is vexed to see that Aahil still has feelings for Sanam. Haya is awakened by Faiz's voice, and he tries to scare her. Further, Tanveer plans a trap to harm Sunehri.

episodesList.title: Episode 584
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam decides to perform black magic on Sanam. Rahat adopts strict security measures for Haya's protection. Meanwhile, Tanveer fakes a call to dupe Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 585
episodesList.summary: Tanveer's plan to defame Seher and Aahil fails, as Seher switches places with Sanam. Later, Seher and Sanam crosswords with her. Meanwhile, Haya worries about Rahat's safety.

episodesList.title: Episode 586
episodesList.summary: Tanveer is impressed with Nayi Sanam's renewed zeal to win Aahil's love. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam uses her spells on Aahil. Later, Tanveer reminds Aahil of Nawab's death anniversary.

episodesList.title: Episode 587
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam succeeds in preventing Sanam from going to the 'dargah' with Aahil. Sanam doubts Nayi Sanam after witnessing her changed behaviour. Rehaan pledges to expose Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 588
episodesList.summary: Rehaan and Sanam fail to find any evidence in Tanveer's room. Meanwhile, Faiz kidnaps Rahat. Later, Sanam finds the missing newspaper that she had been frantically looking for.

episodesList.title: Episode 589
episodesList.summary: According to the plan, Nayi Sanam slips into Aahil's bed, and Tanveer calls Sanam to witness his infidelity. Later, Nayi Sanam insults Sanam for interfering in her conjugal life.

episodesList.title: Episode 590
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam lies to Aahil about their intimacy. Further, Sanam is hurt by Aahil's misbehaviour. Meanwhile, Tanveer fails to find Asad and Zoya's photograph in her room.

episodesList.title: Episode 591
episodesList.summary: Tanveer gets the newspaper clipping. When the reads the Quran, Nayi Sanam is unable to stand it. Later, Rahat falls from the terrace. Tanveer learns that her child is alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 592
episodesList.summary: Seher gets the newspaper cutting and asks Sanam and Rehaan to expose Tanveer. Aahil admits that he had killed Nawab and that Tanveer had saved him by taking the blame upon herself.

episodesList.title: Episode 593
episodesList.summary: Sanam proves Aahil's innocence in Anwar’s murder, much to his relief. Later, Faiz meets with an accident. At Seher's instigation, Aahil vows to bring the killer before Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 594
episodesList.summary: Sanam and Seher learn that Tanveer can see. Further, Aahil tells Sanam about Suleiman and decides to seek his help. Haya dresses up as a widow. Later, the police question Faiz.

episodesList.title: Episode 595
episodesList.summary: At the doss-house, Tanveer learns that Jamila adopted her daughter. Suleiman tells Aahil that he is unaware of Tanveer's true colours. Haya withdraws her charge against Faiz.

episodesList.title: Episode 596
episodesList.summary: Suleiman dreads Tanveer and lies to Aahil. Further, Tanveer threatens Suleiman to leave the city, but Sanam urges him to tell Aahil the truth. Later, Haya decides to kill Faiz.

episodesList.title: Episode 597
episodesList.summary: Rehaan thwarts Tanveer's effort to stop him. Nayi Sanam informs Tanveer about Aahil and Suleiman's meeting. Later, She performs black magic to stop Aahil from meeting Suleiman.

episodesList.title: Episode 598
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam's magic works, as the tyre of Aahil's car gets punctured. Further, Aahil meets Sanam and Suleiman at a temple. Sanam asks Aahil not to disclose his location to Tanveer.

episodesList.title: Episode 599
episodesList.summary: Rehaan notices that Tanveer is about to kill Aahil and rushes to save him. Rehaan gets shot by Tanveer and dies instantly. Later, Nayi Sanam shoots Suleiman and drags Tanveer away.

episodesList.title: Episode 600
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam provokes Tanveer against Sanam and Seher. Haya seeks revenge against Faiz for his actions. Later, Sanam informs Seher about Rehaan's death, which leaves her heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Episode 601
episodesList.summary: Tanveer decides to seek revenge against Sanam and Seher. Seher goes to Rehaan's funeral, but Tanveer refuses to let her see the body. Later, Tanveer asks Aahil to take Sanam away.

episodesList.title: Episode 602
episodesList.summary: Seher is upset after seeing Rehaan's body from afar. At night, Seher visits Rehaan's grave, and Nayi Sanam hits her on her head. Later, Nayi Sanam coaxes Tanveer to seek revenge.

episodesList.title: Episode 603
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tells Sanam that she has kidnapped Seher and threatens to kill her. Faiz extends an inappropriate proposition to Haya. Sanam burns the diary while Aahil tries to stop her.

episodesList.title: Episode 604
episodesList.summary: Faiz tries to take advantage of Haya, but Rahat returns and stops him. Haya and Rahat reprimand Faiz for his actions. Later, Tanveer gives Sanam five minutes to save Seher.

episodesList.title: Episode 605
episodesList.summary: Faiz challenges Rahat to a fight, and they decide to battle each other. Further, Faiz falls on a sharp object and dies. Later, Sanam goes to save Seher and tries to untie her.

episodesList.title: Episode 606
episodesList.summary: Tanveer traps Sanam and Seher and also ties them up. Later, Nayi Sanam and Tanveer celebrate their success. Aahil receives clues about Anwar’s killer and decides to investigate.

episodesList.title: Episode 607
episodesList.summary: Tanveer searches for her daughter frantically and reaches the doll factory to talk to the imprisoned Nawab. Later, when Aahil finds a clue, he drives back to the factory.

episodesList.title: Episode 608
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tries to call her daughter but leaves a voice message when the call does not connect. Later, Sanam reveals Tanveer's secrets to Aahil, who is shocked.

episodesList.title: Episode 609
episodesList.summary: Sanam reveals Tanveer's dirty secrets to Aahil, who questions Tanveer. Thereafter, Tanveer takes Aahil to the basement and locks him up. Later, She prepares to shoot Seher.

episodesList.title: Episode 610
episodesList.summary: Aahil stops Sanam from shooting Tanveer. Later, Tanveer fires a cannon at the Qureshi family but is herself fatally hurt from the backward thrust of the cannon.

episodesList.title: Episode 611
episodesList.summary: Tanveer pushes Aahil away and says that he is not her son. Later, Sanam tells Aahil that the tumultuous phase in their lives has strengthened their relationship.

episodesList.title: Episode 612
episodesList.summary: Sanam and Aahil leave for the 'dargah' without Seher, who is to join them afterwards. Later, Sanam ties a 'tabeez' around Aahil's neck to stave off the forces of evil from him.

episodesList.title: Episode 613
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam imprisons Seher in a cage. She tells Seher that evil never ends but comes in different forms. Later, Nayi Sanam sends an imprisoned Seher's picture to Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 614
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam sells Seher to a prostitution racket. When Sanam learns about it, Nayi Sanam blackmails her. Later, Sanam finds the truck that is carrying Seher.

episodesList.title: Episode 615
episodesList.summary: Sanam looks for Seher in the truck while Seher sneaks out. Sanam gets trapped and enquires a girl about Seher. Further, Seher escapes from the goons but gets hit by a truck.

episodesList.title: Episode 616
episodesList.summary: Aahil looks for Sanam, but he is unable to find her. Thereafter, Gazalla and Razaq spy on Nayi Sanam. Later, Sanam gets thrown out of the truck and falls into a river.

episodesList.title: Episode 617
episodesList.summary: Sanam gains consciousness and finds herself in a deserted area. Further, Sanam loses her memory and asks commoners for help. Later, Nayi Sanam performs black magic on Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 618
episodesList.summary: Sanam flees after witnessing a murder. Further, Nayi Sanam learns that Sanam has disappeared after the truck met with an accident. Later, Aahil evicts Nayi Sanam from the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 619
episodesList.summary: Revolters chase Sanam to kill her, and she runs for her life. Thereafter, Shaad breaks down to find Liyaqat's dead body. Later, Shaad protects Sanam and fights the revolters.

episodesList.title: Episode 620
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam sends Aahil a picture of an imprisoned Sanam. Meanwhile, Sanam thinks herself to be Jannat, who is married to Shaad. Later, Shaad enquires Jannat about Liyaqat's murder.

episodesList.title: Episode 621
episodesList.summary: Aahil enquires Nayi Sanam about her injury. She lies to Aahil about Sanam being killed. Shaad takes Jannat to a clinic and learns that she lost her memory.

episodesList.title: Episode 622
episodesList.summary: Shaad plans to take revenge on Shashi for Liyaqat's death and keeps the file inside a secret vault. Thereafter, Shaad refuses to marry Misbah, but his father forces him.

episodesList.title: Episode 623
episodesList.summary: Shaad admits in front of everyone that Jannat is his wife. Further, Misbah is revealed to be Tanveer's daughter. Aahil takes Nayi Sanam to the doctor, and she fears being exposed.

episodesList.title: Episode 624
episodesList.summary: Aftaab asks Misbah to stay in his house. Elsewhere, the doctor spots a knife in Nayi Sanam's X-ray report, and she kills him. Later, a man carrying a gun sneaks into Shaad's house.

episodesList.title: Episode 625
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam finds out that Nazia is pregnant and decides to use it to her advantage. Later, she forces Aahil to announce her pregnancy to the media. Meanwhile, Jannat meets Misbah.

episodesList.title: Episode 626
episodesList.summary: Upon seeing Misbah's face, Jannat feels angry. Thereafter, Misbah advises Aftaab to organise a reception for Shaad and Jannat. A masked Shashi Kapoor plans to disrupt Shaad's life.

episodesList.title: Episode 627
episodesList.summary: Jannat gets angry when she sees Misbah. Hence, Misbah decides not to attend Shaad's reception. Elsewhere, Aahil misses Sanam, and Nayi Sanam asks him to forget her.

episodesList.title: Episode 628
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam blackmails Aahil. Huma tries to talk to Aahil regarding something important about Nayi Sanam. Meanwhile, everyone except Jannat faints at her wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 629
episodesList.summary: Shashi finds the key to the locker where Shaad keeps the files. However, Jannat catches her trying to steal from the locker. Nayi Sanam finds Huma and makes her kill herself.

episodesList.title: Episode 630
episodesList.summary: The Pakistan army traces Jannat’s call to Aahil and arrives at Shaad’s house. Aahil learns that Nayi Sanam’s doctor has passed away. Shashi drops her fake thumb in a dustbin.

episodesList.title: Episode 631
episodesList.summary: Shashi retrieves her fake thumb. Meanwhile, Aahil finds that Nayi Sanam possesses apparatuses for performing black magic. Jannat asks Shaad to have her talk to her parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 632
episodesList.summary: Jannat dials Aahil’s number, but Aahil fails to receive her call. Later, Dilawar goes into a coma before giving Aahil the information about Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 633
episodesList.summary: Sanam fails to recognise Aahil when they talk over the phone. Meanwhile, Jannat catches Shashi trying to open Shaad's locker. Nayi Sanam finds out that Sanam is still alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 634
episodesList.summary: Shaad gives Jannat a watch that can send an SOS signal to him. Later, Jannat sends a distress signal to Shaad. He runs back to Jannat while leaving Shashi in his car.

episodesList.title: Episode 635
episodesList.summary: Shashi breaks the window of Shaad's car and comes out just before the bomb explodes. Meanwhile, Shaad interrupts Nayi Sanam before she can poison Jannat.

episodesList.title: Episode 636
episodesList.summary: Shaad tells Jannat the story of his mother. Later, Jannat tries to solve Shaad's problems. Nayi Sanam tells Razaq that Aahil will not accept Sanam even if she regains her memory.

episodesList.title: Episode 637
episodesList.summary: Shashi wants to kill Shaad and Jannat. Nayi Sanam draws Razaq's and Gazalla's blood and makes a magical potion with it. Later, Shaad recites a 'shayari' for Jannat.

episodesList.title: Episode 638
episodesList.summary: Jannat has visions of Aahil as Shaad is about to put a ring on her finger. Shashi crushes Shaad's watch. Later, Wahida tries to throw away Shashi's gun but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 639
episodesList.summary: An armed Shashi accompanies Shaad, Jannat, Aftaab and Wahida to the tomb of Chand Bibi. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam pours her potion into the pool and throws Aahil into it.

episodesList.title: Episode 640
episodesList.summary: A masked person kicks Shaad from the edge of a cliff. Later, Misbah locks Jannat inside a maze. Elsewhere, Aahil vows to punish Nayi Sanam as he knows about her evil plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 641
episodesList.summary: In Aahil's office, he asks an employee to keep Nayi Sanam busy while he makes a phone call to inquire about Sanam. Shaad enters a maze near the tomb of Chand Bibi to find Jannat.

episodesList.title: Episode 642
episodesList.summary: Shaad finds an injured Jannat. Aahil mistakenly shoots Nayi Sanam as he blames her for Sanam's death. Shaad thinks that Shashi is responsible for Jannat's condition.

episodesList.title: Episode 643
episodesList.summary: Jannat is curious about Misbah's identity, and she resolves to find out the truth. Aahil learns that Nayi Sanam is not pregnant. Jannat tries to find the keys to a locked room.

episodesList.title: Episode 644
episodesList.summary: Jannat finds a gun in Misbah's room, and she takes it. Later, Misbah takes the gun from Jannat's room. When Jannat tells Shaad about Misbah's gun, he finds it hard to believe.

episodesList.title: Episode 645
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam tries to entice Aahil, but he manages to escape her allurement. Jannat follows Misbah into an empty godown and learns that she has kept a lady hostage.

episodesList.title: Episode 646
episodesList.summary: Jannat learns that the lady hostage is the real Misbah. Further, she brings her home with her. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam introduces Saif as Nazia's boyfriend to Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 647
episodesList.summary: The fake Misbah is worried to find the real Misbah missing. Nayi Sanam checks into a hotel with Saif, and Aahil follows them. The fake Misbah finds another woman in Jannat's room.

episodesList.title: Episode 648
episodesList.summary: Jannat fails to expose Shashi's ploy as she succeeds in kidnapping Misbah again. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam's dress catches fire as she tries to get close to Saif in the hotel room.

episodesList.title: Episode 649
episodesList.summary: Jannat finds an excuse to search the house to find Misbah. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam is horrified to learn the reason behind Aahil's plan to test the truth of her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Episode 650
episodesList.summary: Jannat fails to find Misbah. Further, Nayi Sanam makes up an excuse for not taking the pregnancy test as she does not find Nazia. Later, the immigration officer arrests Jannat.

episodesList.title: Episode 651
episodesList.summary: Aahil refuses to accept the test results and demands a paternity test. Jannat stuns Shashi's men and manages to escape. Nayi Sanam reveals the name of the father of her child.

episodesList.title: Episode 652
episodesList.summary: Aahil seeks advice from Nayi Sanam's mother. Meanwhile, Jannat returns home and is shocked to find Misbah's dead body. Later, Shashi holds Jannat at gunpoint as Wahida exposes her.

episodesList.title: Episode 653
episodesList.summary: While Jannat prevents Shashi from killing Aftaab, Nayi Sanam tells Aahil about Nazia's pregnancy. Later, Shashi tries to strike a deal with Jannat to extract the file.

episodesList.title: Episode 654
episodesList.summary: Tanveer tries to scare Jannat by suffocating her with gas. Further, Nazia is ready for her engagement with Saif. However, Saif wants to be with Nayi Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 655
episodesList.summary: Tanveer kills Wahida and flees. Shaad follows her in an attempt to capture her. At the ring ceremony, Saif expresses his love for Nayi Sanam but completes the ceremony with Nazia.

episodesList.title: Episode 656
episodesList.summary: Tanveer apparently dies after a fall. Shaad identifies the fingers of the dead body. Further, Jannat and Shaad visit India. Aahil is confident that fate will unite him with Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 657
episodesList.summary: Jannat and Shaad meet Mithilesh in Delhi. Shashi tries to create an explosion. Aahil conspires to escape from the trip. Further, Aahil believes that he is destined to meet Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 658
episodesList.summary: Mithilesh tries to ruin Shashi's attempt of the bombing. Shaad and Aahil encounter each other. Later, Jannat and Aahil accidentally exchange a few words at the airport shoe store.

episodesList.title: Episode 659
episodesList.summary: Aahil helps Shaad to diffuse the bomb. Further, Mithilesh detains Nayi Sanam. Meanwhile, Shashi escapes from the police. Later, Aahil goes to Dharamshala to get rid of Nayi Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 660
episodesList.summary: Coincidentally, Aahil, Shaad and Jannat stay at the same hotel. Nayi Sanam tries to romance Saif but is interrupted. Meanwhile, Aahil likes the scarf that Jannat chooses for Shaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 661
episodesList.summary: On hearing Aahil's voice, Jannat tries to follow him. Shaad learns that someone has already asked the artist to sketch Jannat's portrait. Later, Nayi Sanam is shocked to see Nazia.

episodesList.title: Episode 662
episodesList.summary: Aahil gets hurt while trying to save Shaad. As Aahil holds Jannat's hand, she recollects snippets of her past. Later, Nazia tells Nayi Sanam that she is going to sleep beside her.

episodesList.title: Episode 663
episodesList.summary: Aahil and Shaad share with each other about the love of their lives. Nayi Sanam learns that Aahil has ousted her from his property. Later, Aahil stands next to Sanam and prays.

episodesList.title: Episode 664
episodesList.summary: Aahil is delighted to see Sanam at the temple. Further, he learns that Jannat has lost her memory in an accident. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam's mother gives her a pair of slippers.

episodesList.title: Episode 665
episodesList.summary: Jannat thinks Sanam is just like her. Further, Aahil asks Jannat how she had met Shaad. Meanwhile, at the 'Haveli', the buyers humiliate Nayi Sanam and throw her out of the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 666
episodesList.summary: When Shaad learns that Shashi is in Bhopal, he agrees with Aahil's suggestion to take Jannat to Bhopal. Shashi vows to wreck Bhopal. Later, Shaad, Jannat and Aahil visit a mosque.

episodesList.title: Episode 667
episodesList.summary: Aahil learns that Nayi Sanam is pregnant and brings her home. Jannat invites Aahil to watch meteor showers. Further, Nayi Sanam asks Gazalla and Lateef to keep an eye on Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 668
episodesList.summary: Nazia questions Saif and Nayi Sanam, but the latter pacifies the situation. Aahil and Jannat wish upon the stars. Later, Shaad feels insecure about Jannat and Aahil's closeness.

episodesList.title: Episode 669
episodesList.summary: Aahil packs Jannat's bag and decides to visit her. Nayi Sanam learns about Aahil's plans and locks herself in Jannat's bag. Later, Shashi Kapoor disguises herself as a politician.

episodesList.title: Episode 670
episodesList.summary: Aahil brings Jannat's luggage to the hotel, but Nayi Sanam gets locked in it. Shaad learns that Shashi Kapoor has disguised herself. Further, Aahil talks to Jannat about Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 671
episodesList.summary: Aahil receives Noor's call, and they set up a meeting with the family. Shaad tells the truth to Jannat, but the latter falls asleep. Later, Nayi Sanam spots Jannat near the hotel.

episodesList.title: Episode 672
episodesList.summary: Aahil takes Jannat to his house, and she vaguely remembers her earlier memories. Later, Aahil asks Jannat to look at his wife's picture, but Nayi Sanam intervenes.

episodesList.title: Episode 673
episodesList.summary: Aahil doubts Nayi Sanam's motives and stops Jannat from consuming a betel leaf. Nayi Sanam puts up an act in front of Jannat. Further, Jannat gets upset with Aahil's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Episode 674
episodesList.summary: Aahil and Nayi Sanam are shocked to meet Noor as they find a striking familiarity. Noor and Shaad put up an act in front of everyone. Further, Nazia refers to Jannat as Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 675
episodesList.summary: Jannat, who is a guest, seems to be too familiar with Aahil's house and instructs a waiter perfectly. Later, Aahil reads out a scroll announcing Jannat and Shaad's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 676
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam is determined to get Shaad and Jannat married so that Aahil cannot unite with Jannat. Later, Shashi advises Saif to carry on with his affair with Nayi Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 677
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam declares that Aahil would buy Jannat's wedding dress. Thereafter, Lateef and Gazalla lock up Aahil and Jannat in a room. Later, Aahil asks Jannat if she loves Shaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 679
episodesList.summary: Shashi tries to figure out why she resembles Tanveer. Thereafter, Saif and Nayi Sanam share a sensuous moment in the bedroom. Later, Shashi makes Nazia fall down.

episodesList.title: Episode 678
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam burns an album of photographs that has Jannat's pictures in it. Later, Jannat arrives at Aahil's house and tells him that she has consented for her wedding with Shaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 680
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam replaces Shaad's letter to Jannat with a loving note. Meanwhile, Shashi learns secrets about the Ibrahim family. Later, Shaad encourages Aahil about finding Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 681
episodesList.summary: Jannat does not react to the letter, and Shaad thinks that she has accepted his truth. As Lateef snaps the air conditioner's wire, Shaad and Jannat come to sleep in Aahil's room.

episodesList.title: Episode 682
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam tampers with the microwave so that it blasts when Jannat opens its door. Later, Aahil prevents Jannat from getting hurt, and Jannat has a feeling of déjà vu.

episodesList.title: Episode 683
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam mixes chilli in the biryani to humiliate Jannat. Thereafter, Tanveer infuses poison in the pie and asks Aahil to eat it. Later, Shaad eats the poisoned pie and faints.

episodesList.title: Episode 684
episodesList.summary: Shashi decides to kill Jannat and Aahil to avenge Tanveer's death. Further, Aahil informs Jannat that Shaad is out of danger. Later, Aahil learns that the car brakes have failed.

episodesList.title: Episode 685
episodesList.summary: Jannat regains her memory after the accident. Thereafter, Sanam faints again, and Aahil splashes water on her face. Aahil gets shocked to see Jannat losing her memory yet again.

episodesList.title: Episode 686
episodesList.summary: Aahil and Sanam are taken to the tribal village. Aahil performs a difficult task for the tribal people and impresses them. Later, Nayi Sanam plans to cast a spell on Shaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 687
episodesList.summary: The tribal man announces Kasturi's wedding with Aahil. However, Aahil refuses to marry Kasturi. Thereafter, Nayi Sanam instigates a worried Shaad against Jannat and Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 688
episodesList.summary: Aahil tells Jannat that he dreamt of having a family with her as he loves her the most. Thereafter, Aahil convinces the tribal people to kill him and let Jannat go.

episodesList.title: Episode 689
episodesList.summary: When Aahil tries to kiss Jannat, she slaps him. Further, Nayi Sanam informs Shaad that Aahil and Jannat have met with an accident. Nazia weeps after learning about Aahil's death.

episodesList.title: Episode 690
episodesList.summary: Jannat and Aahil arrive at the house, and everyone gets shocked to see them alive. Thereafter, Jannat rushes to Shaad and hugs him while Aahil breaks down to see them together.

episodesList.title: Episode 691
episodesList.summary: Shashi devises a new plan to kill Aahil. Further, she ignores Juda's call, and he gets offended. Later, Nayi Sanam tries to bring Shaad and Jannat closer.

episodesList.title: Episode 692
episodesList.summary: Shashi intends to kill Aahil during the party. She tells Nayi Sanam that she wants to kill Jannat and needs her help. Later, Shaad notices Sir Juda's call on Shashi's mobile.

episodesList.title: Episode 693
episodesList.summary: Aahil decides to show Jannat their picture. Nayi Sanam insists Jannat wear a modern dress. Later, Sir Juda decides to go to Shashi's party while Shaad is on a lookout for him.

episodesList.title: Episode 694
episodesList.summary: Sir Juda leaves for Shashi's party. The zip of Jannat's dress loosens up, and Nayi Sanam spikes her drink. Later, Aahil agrees to sing, and Shashi plans to electrocute his guitar.

episodesList.title: Episode 695
episodesList.summary: Shashi fails to kill Aahil and witnesses Nayi Sanam's powers. Thereafter, Sir Juda, who is actually Razia, comes to the party. However, Shaad doesn't suspect her.

episodesList.title: Episode 696
episodesList.summary: Sir Juda tells Shashi that she knows about her origin. Elsewhere, Shaad spots Aahil and Jannat's picture and gets surprised. He confronts Aahil and asks him to tell him the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 697
episodesList.summary: Aahil tells Shaad that Jannat is Sanam. Hence, Shaad decides to tell Jannat the truth. Later, Sir Juda tells Shashi about her transformation from Razia to Sir Juda.

episodesList.title: Episode 698
episodesList.summary: Sir Juda advises Shashi to win over Nazia's trust and use her to take revenge on Aahil. A man comes to Aahil's house, whom Jannat suspects to be the caller, who had threatened her.

episodesList.title: Episode 699
episodesList.summary: Shaad proves that Sanam loves Aahil more. He also vows to help Sanam remember her past love life with Aahil. Later, Nayi Sanam makes Sanam sick by using her black magic skills.

episodesList.title: Episode 700
episodesList.summary: Qubool Hai is a Hindi romantic drama television series starring Surbhi jyoti, Karan Singh Grover and Karanvir Bohra.The story revolves around Zoya, a NRI, who comes to Bhopal in search of her biological father. Zoyas cousin forces her to get married but she escapes and lands in the house of Khans where she falls in love with Asad. Zoya and Asad get married but their life turns into one big roller coaster ride.

episodesList.title: Episode 701
episodesList.summary: Aahil prays for a miracle to God to help him get out of the room and tend to Sanam. A stole comes flying and lands on him, and he finally gets out of the room to help Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 702
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam performs black magic to make Sanam blind and deaf but fails. Sanam tells Aahil that he does not deserve love, and she loves Shaad. Later, Noor gains Nazia’s trust.

episodesList.title: Episode 703
episodesList.summary: Shaad convinces Sanam to attend the Quran recitation that Aahil is holding. When Noor sees Saif with his girlfriend, she beats him to solidify Nazia’s trust in her.

episodesList.title: Episode 704
episodesList.summary: Sanam has decided to marry Shaad, but she faces the dilemma of choosing between Shaad and Aahil. Meanwhile, the reporters inform Mersaab that the police have found the explosives.

episodesList.title: Episode 705
episodesList.summary: Saif gives Nazia's saree to Nayi Sanam and asks her to spend the first night of his marriage with him. Nazia is reluctant to marry Saif, but they get married anyway.

episodesList.title: Episode 706
episodesList.summary: Saif tries to get intimate with Nayi Sanam after his wedding with Nazia. During Shaad and Sanam's wedding vows, Shaad lets Aahil take his place to get him married to Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 707
episodesList.summary: Jannat gets intimate with Shaad. Saif sleeps with Nayi Sanam on his first wedding night. Later, Nayi Sanam shows Shaad pictures of him and Sanam in intimate positions.

episodesList.title: Episode 708
episodesList.summary: Shaad promises Aahil that he will unite him with Sanam. Mayor Sahiba reveals her true identity to Nayi Sanam and teams up with her. Later, Jannat, Aahil and Shaad pray separately.

episodesList.title: Episode 709
