episodesList.summary: Jannat feels guilty for feeling attracted to Aahil. Shashi plans to attack India. Later, Nayi Sanam vows not to let Aahil get the injection, which he has ordered for Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 710
episodesList.summary: Shaad decides to tell Jannat the truth about her life on 'Eid'. However, Jannat decides to return to Pakistan with Shaad as she feels uncomfortable in Aahil's presence.

episodesList.title: Episode 711
episodesList.summary: Shaad and Nayi Sanam try to stop Jannat from going to Pakistan. Nayi Sanam shows a clay statue of Shaad to Shashi. Later, a look-alike of Shaad shoots down a few men.

episodesList.title: Episode 712
episodesList.summary: Shaad's look-alike, Murtaza, enters Aahil's house and gets drawn towards the women and the food. Saif and Nayi Sanam look for Murtaza. Later, Nayi Sanam addresses Shaad as Murtaza.

episodesList.title: Episode 713
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam wants Murtaza to lay low, but he approaches Jannat, who is oblivious of his real identity. Further, Aahil is outside a mosque, and he spots Murtaza entering a bar.

episodesList.title: Episode 714
episodesList.summary: Nayi Sanam and Aahil follow Murtaza into a bar. Nayi Sanam drugs Murtaza and takes him away. Later, Aahil is concerned that Sanam might be distressed about Shaad's condition.

episodesList.title: Episode 715
episodesList.summary: Murtaza forgets his shoes at Aahil's place and leaves. Shaad learns about his lookalike and finds his shoes. Further, Sanam feels uncomfortable about her feelings for Aahil.

episodesList.title: Episode 716
episodesList.summary: Shaad is at Shashi's party, and he keeps an eye on a masked Murtaza. After Shaad reveals himself, he gets into a scuffle with Murtaza. Later, Shashi threatens Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 717
episodesList.summary: Shashi sends Murtaza and Aahil to fetch Sanam's medicines. Murtaza tells Aahil to meet him and Sanam at the Hilltop. Further, Sanam is confused to see Shaad following Murtaza.

episodesList.title: Episode 718
episodesList.summary: Shaad and Murtaza get into a brawl. Murtaza throws Sanam and Aahil off the cliff. Further, Razia tells Nayi Sanam and Shashi that their goal is still incomplete.

episodesList.title: Episode 719
episodesList.summary: Shashi taunts a captive Shaad and informs him about her plan to kill Nazia. Meanwhile, Jannat returns home and makes a shocking revelation as Nayi Sanam tries to stab her.

episodesList.title: Episode 720
episodesList.summary: Sanam recalls her lost memories and blames Nayi Sanam for her losses. She is resolute to wreak vengeance on all her wrongdoers. Later, Nayi Sanam falls prey to Sanam's laid trap.

episodesList.title: Episode 721
episodesList.summary: Sanam visits Aahil's grave. Meanwhile, Shaad attacks the goons but fails to escape. Later, Sanam manages to enter Shashi's house and eavesdrops on Shashi and Saif's conversation.

episodesList.title: Episode 722
episodesList.summary: Sanam takes up a disguise to enter the conference. When Shashi spots Shaad, she thinks of postponing her plan. Later, Razia sedates Shaad as he tries to give Sanam a letter.

episodesList.title: Episode 723
episodesList.summary: Sanam succeeds in saving Nazia and replaces the jacket containing the bomb with Saif's. Later, Shashi manages to escape from her house, but Saif dies in the blast.

episodesList.title: Episode 724
episodesList.summary: Murtaza refuses to believe that Sanam is alive. Meanwhile, Shashi is determined to kill Shaad. However, Shaad gets hold of Shashi's mobile and calls up the Pakistani intelligence.

episodesList.title: Episode 725
episodesList.summary: Sanam kills Murtaza in a fit of rage. Sanam and Wazira express vexation towards Shashi. Further, a video recording reveals Shashi's plot to create a bomb blast.

episodesList.title: Episode 726
episodesList.summary: Sanam confronts Shashi at the event. She asks Shashi to disclose Shaad's whereabouts. Although Shashi accepts her deeds, her aides detain Sanam, who vows to avenge Aahil's death.

episodesList.title: Episode 727
episodesList.summary: Sanam sets out to find Shaad and give him justice. Nayi Sanam fears being killed by Sanam. Later, Razia boasts of her plotting abilities in keeping Shaad confided.

episodesList.title: Episode 728
episodesList.summary: Sanam puts all her efforts in finding Shaad. Razia's plot succeeds, and she plants a bomb on Shaad. Further, Wazira is hurt during the combat. Later, Sanam watches Shaad die.

episodesList.title: Episode 729
episodesList.summary: Razia survives and pledges to spread terrorism. The police applaud Sanam, who decides to destroy Nayi Sanam. Later, Nayi Sanam tries to employ magical powers to kill Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 730
episodesList.summary: Sanam comes to Nayi Sanam's mother's aid. Later, Sanam shoots Nayi Sanam, but Nayi Sanam remains alive. When Nayi Sanam tries to shoot Sanam, her mother arrives to save Sanam.

episodesList.title: Episode 731
episodesList.summary: When Sanam and Nayi Sanam's mother make Nayi Sanam look at the talisman, she loses her powers. Thereafter, Nayi Sanam kills her mother and asks Sanam to return the talisman to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 732
episodesList.summary: Sanam commits suicide. Nasir saves Nayi Sanam from committing suicide. After marrying Nasir, Nayi Sanam is known as Khan Begum, and she swears to recoup all that she has lost.

episodesList.title: Episode 733
episodesList.summary: Mahira enters the 'Haveli' to stay with Saira and Bano. When Nasir insults Khan Begum, Azaad warns Nasir against it. Later, Khan Begum asks Azaad to bring her a 'neeli kachnar'.

episodesList.title: Episode 734
episodesList.summary: Azaad saves Mahira from an accident. Further, Khan Begum is astounded to see Mahira. Thereafter, Saira and Bano introduce Mahira as their sister to a shocked Khan Begum.

episodesList.title: Episode 735
episodesList.summary: Saira and Bano intentionally tell Mahira to clean Azaad’s room. Further, on seeing Azaad, a Pir Baba foretells that Mahira will find her true love at the 'Haveli'.

episodesList.title: Episode 736
episodesList.summary: Azaad asks Mahira to get out of his room. Further, Khan Begum fires Mahira, Saira and Bano. Later, Mahira apologises to Azaad, who pardons her but asks her to stay out of his way.

episodesList.title: Episode 737
episodesList.summary: Azaad's wound heals by itself. Azaad pledges to bring the 'neeli kachnar' for Khan Begum. Mahira encourages Kainaat. Later, Mahira tells Azaad that she is not afraid of him.

episodesList.title: Episode 738
episodesList.summary: Kainaat meets Akram, and the families finalise their union. Mahira learns that Akram is a cheat and tells the family about it, while Akram's family overhears her accusations.

episodesList.title: Episode 739
episodesList.summary: Mahira fails to prove Akram's actions to the family, and Azaad asks her to leave the house. A distraught Mahira leaves the house. Further, Khan Begum vows to regain her powers.

episodesList.title: Episode 740
episodesList.summary: Mahira manages to find proof against Akram. Azaad reveals Mahira's disguise, and Khan Begum slaps her. Thereafter, Akram accidentally plays a video, which proves his misdeeds.

episodesList.title: Episode 741
episodesList.summary: Zohra discloses Akram's truth to everyone. Amaad apologises to Mahira and asks her for a date. Further, Azaad and Mahira look for 'neeli kachnar' that contains magical properties.

episodesList.title: Episode 742
episodesList.summary: A scared Mahira fails to get the special flower after noticing Azaad's eyes. Azaad gives the 'neeli kachnar' to Khan Begum for Kainaat. Later, Azaad is hungry for more blood.

episodesList.title: Episode 743
episodesList.summary: The 'neeli kachnar' catches fire, and Khan begum fails to regain her powers. Mahira learns about vampires from her father's books. Further, Khan Begum goes to meet Sardar-e-Ifrit.

episodesList.title: Episode 744
episodesList.summary: Sardar-e-Ifrit tells Khan Begum about the process to regain her power. Mahira is marked by a special sign. The police question Azaad about his whereabouts, and he lies to them.

episodesList.title: Episode 745
episodesList.summary: Azaad informs Khan Begum about Akram's reality. When Mahira gets ready for her date, Saira and Bano try to injure her. Further, Azaad behaves rudely with Mahira and dismisses her.

episodesList.title: Episode 746
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum meets Razia, who uses her witchery to help Khan Begum locate the girl with the mark. Meanwhile, Amaad tries to turn Mahira against Azaad by lying about him.

episodesList.title: Episode 747
episodesList.summary: Razia tries her best to reveal the identity of the girl with the mark to Khan Begum. However, Azaad inadvertently hinders this process when he prevents Mahira from falling.

episodesList.title: Episode 748
episodesList.summary: Azaad catches Mahira secretly clicking his photograph. When Mahira falls in the mud, Azaad helps her clean up. Later, Amaad flirts with Mahira to annoy Azaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 749
episodesList.summary: Mahira annoys Azaad at the party in her attempts to know his weight and eye colour. Later, Khan Begum gags Nisha and takes her to her room, then tries to drown her.

episodesList.title: Episode 750
episodesList.summary: When Mahira is about to spot her with Nisha's dead body, Khan Begum has a narrow escape. However, Mahira falls and loses her spectacles, which allows Khan Begum to hide the body.

episodesList.title: Episode 751
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum stabs herself with an evil knife, and her spirit looks for the girl with the mark. Later, a woman reads the Holy Quran, and Khan Begum's spirit is ousted from the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 752
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum figures out that it is Mahira whom she had been looking for. Meanwhile, Mahira accidentally falls into the dickey of Azaad's car, and he heads towards the farmhouse.

episodesList.title: Episode 753
episodesList.summary: Mahira teases Azaad, saying that he cares for her. Meanwhile, Razia performs occult rites in Khan Begum's house. Razia says that she can trace Mahira by following her fragrance.

episodesList.title: Episode 754
episodesList.summary: Azaad shuts Mahira in a forest house and injects himself an antidote. Thereafter, when a group of men tries to rape Mahira, she runs away and asks an unconscious Azaad for help.

episodesList.title: Episode 755
episodesList.summary: Razia hurls a powdery substance into Mahira's face, and she loses consciousness. Khan Begum takes out her dagger and chants magical spell to kill Mahira, but she fails to succeed.

episodesList.title: Episode 756
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum swears to kill Mahira for getting close to Azaad. Thereafter, Khan Begum asks Razia to plot against Mahira. Razia gives a pouch to Jhanjhariya to scare Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 757
episodesList.summary: The enchanted blood tries to drown Mahira. However, the amulet falls in the water, and Mahira is saved. Thereafter, Khan Begum gets furious as her plan has backfired.

episodesList.title: Episode 758
episodesList.summary: Mahira feels unwell and falls off the stairs, but Azaad rushes to her rescue and saves her. Further, Khan Begum gets furious with Razia for not keeping the promise.

episodesList.title: Episode 759
episodesList.summary: Mahira turns into a statue, and Azaad realises his love for Mahira and promises to get her back to life. Thereafter, Khan Begum informs Razia that she failed to save Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 760
episodesList.summary: Azaad is in tears as he expresses his love to Mahira’s statue. His tears heal Mahira. Thereafter, Azaad decides to protect Mahira. Akram abducts Kainaat, but Sameer saves her.

episodesList.title: Episode 761
episodesList.summary: Nasir welcomes Razia to his house and asks her to stay with them. Thereafter, Amaad gets a drunken girl to sleep beside Azaad. Further, Mahira remembers that Azaad saved her life.

episodesList.title: Episode 762
episodesList.summary: Razia advises Khan Begum to marry Mahira to Azaad so that Mahira continues to stay in her house. Later, Mahira leaves for Shimla, but Khan Begum gets her kidnapped on the way.

episodesList.title: Episode 763
episodesList.summary: Amaad challenges Azaad that he will make Mahira fall for him. Meanwhile, Khan Begum and Razia ask a beautician to give a makeover to Mahira. Later, Amaad asks Mahira to marry him.

episodesList.title: Episode 764
episodesList.summary: Razia transforms Saira and Bano into dolls with the help of black magic. Further, Khan Begum threatens Mahira that she will kill her siblings if she refuses to marry Amaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 765
episodesList.summary: Mahira agrees to marry Amaad. Afterwards, Mahira realises that her brother is held captive in Azaad's house. Later, she spots him tied up in a room, but he suddenly disappears.

episodesList.title: Episode 766
episodesList.summary: Razia tells Khan Begum that Azaad is Mahira's true love. Hence, Khan Begum has to make Mahira marry Azaad and offer their child to the devil.

episodesList.title: Episode 767
episodesList.summary: A masked man wants to acquire the dolls of Saira and Bano. Later, Razia tells Khan Begum that she will get her powers back if she sacrifices Mahira and Azaad's child.

episodesList.title: Episode 768
episodesList.summary: The masked man asks Kainaat where the dolls are, but she refuses to answer. Later, Khan Begum drugs Amaad, and then he tries to force Mahira to get intimate with him.

episodesList.title: Episode 769
episodesList.summary: The masked man threatens Kainaat and asks her to hand over the dolls to him. Meanwhile, Khan Begum ties up Nasir. Later, Azaad worries about Mahira and decides to marry her.

episodesList.title: Episode 770
episodesList.summary: Razia and Khan Begum plot to marry off Amaad and Azaad at the same time at different venues to different brides. Later, Nasir informs Amaad that his bride is not Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 771
episodesList.summary: Nasir wonders how Mahira can be at two places at the same time. Razia prevents Mahira from hearing the groom’s name during her wedding ceremony to get her married to Azaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 772
episodesList.summary: Amaad turns out to be married to Afreen instead of Mahira. Further, she kills Amaad on their wedding night. Mahira scolds Azaad for marrying her without her knowledge.

episodesList.title: Episode 773
episodesList.summary: Afreen disposes of Amaad’s body. Mahira believes Afreen’s lie that she is Azaad’s first wife. Later, Afreen turns Razia into a doll for trying to use black magic on her.

episodesList.title: Episode 774
episodesList.summary: Afreen decides to have children with Azaad. Khan Begum gets worried and tries to convince Mahira to come back to Azaad. Later, Afreen tries to get intimate with Azaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 775
episodesList.summary: Mahira stops Afreen from getting intimate with Azaad. Afreen's spell on Azaad disables him from moving or speaking. Later, Khan Begum tries to dispose of Nasir's body.

episodesList.title: Episode 776
episodesList.summary: Afreen takes Mahira's appearance for 'muh dikhai' and misbehaves with the guests at the ceremony. Afterwards, Khan Begum figures out that Afreen is taking Mahira's appearance.

episodesList.title: Episode 777
episodesList.summary: In order to impress Azad, Afreen takes Mahira's appearance to welcome Sameer's parents. However, her real appearance starts to get revealed when a priest blesses her.

episodesList.title: Episode 778
episodesList.summary: Camphor vapour changes Afreen's face into the real form. Lateef and Gazalla help Khan Begum bury Nasir. Later, Afreen gets jealous to see Mahira and Azaad getting intimate.

episodesList.title: Episode 779
episodesList.summary: A yellow-eyed Azaad walks into a sharp pointed object. Mahira brings him back to life. Elsewhere, Khan Begum gets a text from Nasir. Later, Afreen tries to attack Mahira but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 780
episodesList.summary: Mahira ties an amulet on Azaad's arm. Meanwhile, Khan Begum finds out that the masked figure is her accomplice. Later, Mahira removes Afreen's ring that enables her to shape shift.

episodesList.title: Episode 781
episodesList.summary: Afreen gets her ring back. Thereafter, she shape shifts into Azaad and deceives Mahira. Khan Begum goes to the masked figure's home and learns that the seven-fingered man is alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 782
episodesList.summary: Afreen realises that Mahira has understood that she is not Azaad. Elsewhere, the seven-fingered man becomes the highest bidder at an auction, in which Khan Begum also takes part.

episodesList.title: Episode 783
episodesList.summary: Mahira cuts Afreen's ponytail off and throws her out of the house. Elsewhere, Khan Begum gets a glimpse of the seven-fingered man named Armaan, who is her son.

episodesList.title: Episode 784
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum tries to meet Armaan but fails. Armaan and Mahira cross paths at the 'dargah'. Later, Mahira hallucinates Afreen and informs Khan Begum and Kainaat about it.

episodesList.title: Episode 785
episodesList.summary: Afreen uses her evil tricks to create problems in Mahira's life. She casts a spell on Azaad. Armaan goes to visit the purse owner's house and meets Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 786
episodesList.summary: Mahira and Armaan get into an argument. Afreen plans to have a baby with Azaad. However, her plan fails. Later, Afreen tries to kill Khan Begum but accidentally stabs Azaad.

episodesList.title: Episode 787
episodesList.summary: Mahira takes Azaad to the hospital. Afreen recognises Armaan as Khan Begum's first child and hits him with her car. Later, Khan Begum finds herself in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Episode 788
episodesList.summary: After Azaad's death, Mahira learns that his heart had been taken out before his burial. She reaches the hospital and sees Khan Begum's signatures on some documents.

episodesList.title: Episode 789
episodesList.summary: Mahira becomes eager to learn about Azaad's heart recipient. Later, Armaan comes as the new owner of Mahira's house. Mahira recognises him as the recipient and refuses to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 790
episodesList.summary: When Mahira learns about Armaan's plan to turn the house into a heritage hotel, she gets furious. Later, she tries to prevent the bulldozer from bringing down the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 791
episodesList.summary: Afreen locks Khan Begum up in the sauna room to kill her, but Ahsaan comes to her rescue. Later, Afreen hypnotises Badi Ammi to save herself from being exposed in front of Armaan.

episodesList.title: Episode 792
episodesList.summary: Afreen Locks Khan Begum Up In The Sauna Room And Increases The Temperature. Thereafter, Ahsaan, Armaan’s Friend, Saves Her And Is Startled To See A Striking Similarity Between Khan Begum And His Deceased Wife. Meanwhile, Badi Ammi Sees Afreen Sneaking Out Of Mahira’s Room And Follows Her. Later, Badi Ammi Accuses Afreen Of Pushing Her In Front Of The Bulldozer, But She Denies It. Later, Afreen Uses Her Supernatural Powers To Hypnotise Badi Ammi And Makes Badi Ammi Praise Her In Front Of Armaan.

episodesList.title: Episode 793
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum stops Afreen from revealing her secret to Armaan. Meanwhile, Afreen tries to establish a bond with Armaan. Later, to his own surprise, Armaan worries about Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 794
episodesList.summary: Afreen Is Shocked To See Khan Begum Alive. She Threatens To Inform Armaan That Khan Begum Is His Biological Mother. However, Khan Begum Uses Witchcraft To Prevent Afreen From Revealing Her Secret. Further, Armaan Is Unable To Comprehend His Sudden Worry For Mahira's Well-being. Meanwhile, Afreen Acts Quickly To Prevent Armaan From Getting Close To Mahira And Uses Her Spells To Get Close To Him. Later, Armaan Gets Worried When The Doctor Informs Him About Mahira’s Deteriorating Health.

episodesList.title: Episode 795
episodesList.summary: While Afreen asks Badi Ammi about Armaan's locket, Armaan decides to get holy water for Mahira's recovery. Later, Afreen uses her powers to find the key and gives it to Armaan.

episodesList.title: Episode 796
episodesList.summary: Afreen reveals the truth about Armaan's parentage. Armaan is heartbroken and confronts Khan Begum. Later, Ahsaan provides shelter to Khan Begum, who feigns memory loss.

episodesList.title: Episode 797
episodesList.summary: Armaan is consoled by Afreen, who is pregnant with Azaad's child. Khan Begun tries to manipulate Ahsaan to let her stay at his home. Later, Armaan saves Mahira from a fire.

episodesList.title: Episode 798
episodesList.summary: Afreen confides in Sameer that she is pregnant with Azaad's child. Armaan expresses concern over Mahira's health. Khan Begum keeps trying to win over Ahsaan with false integrity.

episodesList.title: Episode 799
episodesList.summary: Armaan apologises to Mahira for his past behaviour, but she remains unmoved. Ahsaan is happy with Khan Begum bonding with Imtiaaz. Later, Sameer and Kainaat get engaged.

episodesList.title: Episode 800
episodesList.summary: Kainaat informs Mahira about her engagement. Later, Mahira loses her job owing to her marital status. Armaan and Mahira's bond strengthens, while Ahsaan and Khan Begum get engaged.

episodesList.title: Episode 801
episodesList.summary: When Armaan assaults Mahira's editor, Mahira gets her job back. Later, Armaan cleverly makes Mahira wear the 'Cinderella dress' to his fairytale-themed party.

episodesList.title: Episode 802
episodesList.summary: When Sameer refuses to take the responsibility of Kainaat's baby, Mahira defends her. At the party, Armaan proposes to marry Mahira, but she turns him down.

episodesList.title: Episode 803
episodesList.summary: Ahsaan tells Armaan that he is going to marry Khan Begum despite knowing her truth. Later, Armaan breaks down before Mahira and confesses that Khan Begum is his mother.

episodesList.title: Episode 804
episodesList.summary: Armaan finally forgives Khan Begum for Mahira's sake. Later, Armaan takes Mahira on a picnic, where she reveals to Khan Begum that Azaad is irreplaceable in her life.

episodesList.title: Episode 805
episodesList.summary: Mahira tells Armaan that she is in love with the pain that Azaad's absence has caused her. Later, when Mahira falls off a cliff, Armaan tries to save her.

episodesList.title: Episode 806
episodesList.summary: Armaan is out of danger after a successful operation. Thereafter, Badi Ammi resents Ahsaan's decision to marry Khan Begum. Later, Mahira talks to Azaad's grave to seek guidance.

episodesList.title: Episode 807
episodesList.summary: Mahira is harrowed by internal conflicts regarding her relationship with Armaan. Later, when the smell of garlic nauseates Khan Begum, Badi Ammi's suspicion is confirmed.

episodesList.title: Episode 808
episodesList.summary: Mahira agrees to marry Armaan after he faces religious pressure from some godmen. Meanwhile, Badi Ammi visits a saint, who gives her a dupatta that can expose Khan Begum.

episodesList.title: Episode 809
episodesList.summary: Sanam Foils Badi Ammi's Plan And Puts Her Under Captivity. Sanam And Ahsaan's Nikah Takes Place. Mahira Refuses To Get Married To Armaan And Confronts Him About His Treachery.

episodesList.title: Episode 810
episodesList.summary: Mahira curses herself for believing Armaan and agreeing to marry him. Thereafter, Ahsaan gets married to Sanam. Later, Badi Ammi tries to reveal Sanam's truth to Ahsaan but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 811
episodesList.summary: Mahira and Armaan are shocked to see that Kainaat has tried to commit suicide. Badi Ammi asks Fareeda to give Sanam the holy book. Later, Mahira prepares for Kainaat's wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 812
episodesList.summary: Armaan gives an ultimatum to Mahira. Further, Mahira requests Armaan to keep Kainaat away from their conflict. Later, Badi Ammi gets a holy amulet to expose Sanam's true identity.

episodesList.title: Qubool Hai - Episode 813 - December 04, 2015 - Full Episode - Part 2
episodesList.summary: Kaainat and Sameer marry each other and on the other hand, Khan Begum locks Ehsaan up in his car and lets him suffocate.

episodesList.title: Qubool Hai - Episode 814 - December 5, 2015 - Full Episode - Part 2
episodesList.summary: Kainaat is waiting for Sameer, who shows up in a drunken state. Kainaat is shocked seeing Sameer drunk. Sameer starts behaving rudely with Kainaat and insults her and her handicapped state.

episodesList.title: Episode 815
episodesList.summary: Armaan visits Ahsaan's house after getting a text. Further, Sanam puts a secret charm inside Armaan's pocket, and Badi Ammi notices it. Later, Armaan takes a girl to his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 816
episodesList.summary: Armaan asks Sara to leave the house. Thereafter, Armaan gets furious and throws Mahira out of the house. Later, Sanam rescues Imtiaaz from falling and ruins Badi Ammi's plans.

episodesList.title: Episode 817
episodesList.summary: Shaira, a journalist, invites Armaan and Mahira for an interview on her show. Further, When Ahsaan tries to get close to Sanam, she casts a spell on him and loses her eyesight.

episodesList.title: Episode 818
episodesList.summary: Armaan tries to force Mahira to get intimate with him. However, he feels unwell and faints. Later, Khan Begum tries to get intimate with a man, but Badi Ammi comes into her room.

episodesList.title: Episode 819
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum traps Badi Ammi in a lamp. Elsewhere, Armaan tries to get intimate with Mahira, who pretends to indulge him. However, Armaan gets surprised and makes her back off.

episodesList.title: Episode 820
episodesList.summary: Armaan is left with no option but to agree to Mahira's request. He is left shocked to know that Mahira is responsible for the trouble he had gone through.

episodesList.title: Episode 821
episodesList.summary: Mahira is taken to her room and the condition of the room is not good. She calls up the manager and enquires as to who booked this room. She learns that Armaan had booked this room for her maid.

episodesList.title: Episode 822
episodesList.summary: Armaan assures Mahira that their honeymoon will not be spent fighting and instead they will be spending a romantic time together.

episodesList.title: Episode 823
episodesList.summary: Sanam asks a witch to impersonate her and spend the night with Ahsaan. Later, she pretends to catch Ahsaan cheating on her. Elsewhere, Armaan tries to get intimate with Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 824
episodesList.summary: Sanam accuses Ahsaan and Badi Ammi of beating her and gets them arrested. Elsewhere, Mahira sneaks into the cave where Armaan is held captive. However, some terrorists spot her.

episodesList.title: Episode 825
episodesList.summary: Ahsaan transfers his properties in Sanam's name. Elsewhere, Mahira and Armaan try to escape, but the terrorists threaten to detonate the bomb that is fixed on Armaan's vest.

episodesList.title: Qubool Hai - Episode 826 - December 19, 2015 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Mahira sticks on to Armaan refusing to fear for her life. As the time bomb is about to blow up, Mahira cuts the jacket Armaan is wearing. Finally the two of them throw the jacket with the bomb towards the terrorists and escape the scene. Sanam treats Ehsaan as her servant and fails to notice his grandmother and Immi secretly walking past her. Sanam gets furious when she realizes that Immi has escaped from the house. Mahira and Armaan return home and get emotional as they recollect their past moments of love and hatred for each other. Sanam makes Ehsaan's mother mop the floor and takes a photograph of her. Armaan stays wide awake as he remembers his rude behaviour towards Mahira. The alarm starts to ring and Armaan starts to to get romantic with Mahira. Watch the entire episode of 'Qubool Hain' to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 827
episodesList.summary: Mahira brings home Amaad’s lookalike, Munna Rangila, in order to make him recall his past. Badi Ammi feels tired of Sanam’s torture. Later, Armaan wants Munna out of his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 828
episodesList.summary: Badi Ammi tries to kill Sanam using an amulet. When Munna grabs Mahira’s hand and asks her to come with him, Armaan asks Gazalla and Lateef to throw Munna out of the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 829
episodesList.summary: When Armaan sees Munna trying to take Mahira into his arms, he hits him. Elsewhere, Sanam decides to find out the source of Badi Ammi's power.

episodesList.title: Episode 830
episodesList.summary: Mahira allows Munna to stay at her house. Meanwhile, Ahsaan stops Sanam from killing Badi Ammi. Munna claims that the bride in the wedding photograph resembles Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 831
episodesList.summary: Mahira tries to convince Munna that they had never been married. Meanwhile, the police officers stop Sameer and his girlfriend from killing Kainaat and chase them away.

episodesList.title: Episode 832
episodesList.summary: Armaan takes Mahira to the terrace. Meanwhile, Sanam summons witches to help her kill Badi Ammi. Later, a witch takes Ahsaan’s soul and turns him into a demon.

episodesList.title: Episode 833
episodesList.summary: Mahira prevents Armaan from seeing the wedding picture of her and Amaad. Further, she figures out that Amaad has been pretending to forget his past to enter her house.

episodesList.title: Qubool Hai - Episode 834 - December 29, 2015 - Full Episode - Part 3
episodesList.summary: N/A

episodesList.title: Episode 835
episodesList.summary: Armaan sees texts from a person called S on Mahira's phone. Khan Begum meets her admirer, who is wearing a mask. Later, Armaan doubts whether Mahira is faking her love for him.

episodesList.title: Episode 836
episodesList.summary: Armaan starts doubting Mahira. Khan Begum gets angry to see that the masked man is Ahsaan. Elsewhere, Armaan texts Mahira the identity of S. Later, Armaan asks Amaad about S.

episodesList.title: Episode 837
episodesList.summary: Amaad plays truth and dare with Armaan, Mahira, Gazalla and Lateef. Khan Begum wishes to be freed from the world of evil. Later, she seeks Badi Ammi's forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Episode 838
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum seeks Armaan and Mahira's forgiveness but dies soon after. A nurse tends to Kainaat. Armaan tells Amaad to find the person, who has been texting Mahira.

episodesList.title: Episode 839
episodesList.summary: Amaad tells Armaan that Mahira had met a man named Shahid Nabi. Thereafter, Amaad apologises to Mahira. Later, Mahira feels happy as she gets her pregnancy report.

episodesList.title: Episode 840
episodesList.summary: Amaad sends Armaan an MMS in which an unknown man is getting close with Mahira. Meanwhile, a transformed Kainaat entices Sameer. Later, Mahira tells Armaan that she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Episode 841
episodesList.summary: Kainaat asks Sameer to do three tasks for her. Armaan wants to conduct a DNA test on the baby and Amaad convinces Mahira for it. Later, Mahira asks INR 500 crores as alimony.

episodesList.title: Episode 842
episodesList.summary: A shocked Armaan learns that Mahira is not pregnant with his child and later divorces her. Meanwhile, Kainaat makes Sameer accept in front of everyone that his first wife is dead.

episodesList.title: Episode 843
episodesList.summary: Armaan learns that Mahira is blameless. Amaad succeeds in creating a difference between Armaan and Mahira. Meanwhile, Kainaat scares Sameer and gets him treated by a fake doctor.

episodesList.title: Episode 844
episodesList.summary: Armaan saves Mahira from falling down the stairs. Amaad and Mahira reunite. Later, Kainaat tells Sameer that they must make love. Mahira asks Armaan to eat chilli, and he eats it.

episodesList.title: Episode 845
episodesList.summary: Kainaat makes Sameer sign the property papers and business papers. Further, when Mahira falls down the stairs, the doctor tells Armaan that next twenty-four hours is very critical.

episodesList.title: Episode 846
episodesList.summary: Amaan Overpowers Armaan And Captures Mahira. Amaan Asks Armaan To Choose Between Mahira And His Unborn Child. Sameer Tries To Kill Kainat, But She Overpowers Him.

episodesList.title: Episode 847
episodesList.summary: In order to kill Mahira's daughter, Amaad trades his soul with the devil. Meanwhile, Mahira urges Armaan to find a way so that they can live together with their daughter.

episodesList.title: Episode 848
episodesList.summary: The lawyer explains to Armaan the Islamic rules for him to remarry Mahira. Later, Amaad enters Mahira's house in the guise of a beggar to kill her daughter.

episodesList.title: Episode 849
episodesList.summary: The Islamic society rebukes Armaan and Mahira. An intruder tries to kidnap Mahira's child but fails. Later, the lawyer finds a solution to Armaan and Mahira's problem.

episodesList.title: Episode 850
episodesList.summary: Amaad finally succeeds in kidnapping Mahira's daughter. Meanwhile, Kainaat extracts the truth from her blackmailer. Later, Amaad faints while trying to harm Mahira's baby.

episodesList.title: Episode 851
episodesList.summary: Amaad tries to kill Armaan and Mahira's child. Meanwhile, Khan Begum deceives Mahira and Armaan with her words. Further, Sameer plans to escape to Switzerland.

episodesList.title: Episode 852
episodesList.summary: Amaad and Khan Begum prepare to sacrifice the child. Mahira wants Armaan to live. Further, Kainaat kills Sameer and leaves in a hurry. Later, Khan Begum turns Armaan senseless.

episodesList.title: Episode 853
episodesList.summary: Under a magic spell, Mahira tells Amaad to choose between her and the infant. Khan Begum secretly rescues Armaan and tries to save the baby. Later, one of the witches dies.

episodesList.title: Episode 854
episodesList.summary: Khan Begum and Armaan resolve their differences. Later, she tries to kill the witches. Amaad and Armaan engage in a fight, in which Amaad is killed, and the baby is rescued.

episodesList.title: Episode 855
episodesList.summary: Mahira refuses to accept Armaan’s death and asks Khan Begum to use her powers to resuscitate him. Khan Begum sacrifices her life for Armaan. Later, Mahira and Armaan get married.

episodesList.title: Episode 856
episodesList.summary: As Armaan walks towards Mahira, he falls down unconsious. He is brought home but no amount of effort gets him awake. Sanam declares that Armaan is dead and he has sacrificed his life in their war against the witches. Mahira gets upset with Sanam and decides to sacrifice her life for Armaan's sake. Sanam informs Mahira that Armaan's heart has turned dark and he is no more the human that he was. Mahira still insists on having him back and finally Sanam asks her to choose between Armaan and her baby. Mahira agrees to sacrifice her baby for Armaan's sake. Will Mahira lose her child for ever? Watch Qubool Hai to know more.

plotHtml: The first season of the show focused on the love story of Asad Ahmed Khan and Zoya Farooqui, played by Karan Singh Grover, who was later replaced by Raqesh Bapat, and Surbhi Jyoti. The show was also focused on the lives of Humaira Siddiqui Sheikh, played by Ketki Kadam, Ayaan Ahmed Khan, played by Rishabh Sinha / Vikrant Massey and Haider Sheikh played by Mohit Sehgal. In May 2014, the second season introduced Asad and Zoya's twin daughters, Sanam and Seher (both played by Jyoti), and revolved around their lives 20 years after the death of their parents. Karanvir Bohra portrayed Sanam's husband Aahil Raza Ibrahim. Shehzad Sheikh joined the cast as Rehan Qureshi, Seher's love interest. The third season of the show portrayed Aahil and Sanam's incomplete love story after she loses her memory, is transported to Pakistan, and an imposter takes her place. The fourth season of the show, launched in August 2015 and incorporating supernatural elements, was set 25 years after Sanam's suicide. It focused on the love story of Mahira, who was the result of Sanam's last prayer (again portrayed by Jyoti), and her two husbands - Azaad Iqbal Khan (Rajbeer Singh), who is revealed to be a vampire and is the "fake" Sanam's son, and his long-lost brother, Armaan Iqbal Khan, who receives his heart in a transplant. The show ended in January 2016 after Armaan and Mahira's remarriage.
